• Prepare USCIS forms accurately, especially Forms I-130, I-130A, I-485, I-864, I-765, I-131, G-28 and related filings

• Review client questionnaires and information for accuracy and completeness

• Review supporting documents and evidence

• Identify missing, inconsistent, incorrect or insufficient information

• Ask questions when information is missing or unclear rather than guessing

• Follow up with clients for missing documents and information

• Prepare and organize USCIS filing packages

• Draft routine cover letters and client correspondence

• Make attorney-requested corrections accurately

• Send forms and documents to clients for review

• Organize and maintain electronic case files

• Track USCIS notices, RFEs, biometrics, interviews and other case milestones

• Communicate professionally, patiently and kindly with clients

• Maintain accurate case notes and case status information

• Manage assigned cases and follow through on outstanding tasks



Requirements:



• Prior hands-on U.S. immigration law experience

• Family-based immigration experience strongly preferred

• Experience personally preparing USCIS forms

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong written English

• Strong organizational skills

• Ability to follow detailed instructions

• Comfortable asking questions when information is unclear

• Ability to independently manage multiple cases

• Comfortable learning new technology and systems

• Reliable internet and professional work environment

• Kind, patient and professional with clients



Schedule:



Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week during U.S. Central Time business hours.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Include the following in your application:



Your résumé.

Briefly describe your U.S. immigration law experience and how long you have worked in immigration.

Do you have experience using Camplegal?

Tell us which of the following forms you have personally prepared: G-28, I-130, I-130A, I-485, I-864, I-765, I-131, I-751 and N-400.

Tell us whether you are currently employed or working for any other clients.

In the first line of your application, write the exact words: LOVE HAS NO BORDERS



Applicants who appear to be a good fit will be asked to complete a short practical USCIS form-preparation assessment before being invited to an interview.



The assessment is designed to evaluate attention to detail, USCIS form preparation, ability to follow instructions, and whether you identify missing information rather than guessing.



Please apply only if you are comfortable completing a practical skills assessment as part of the hiring process.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM EST (8 PM to 4 AM MNL)

4 PM to 12 AM EST (4 AM to 12 PM MNL)



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

description:
HOW TO APPLY: complete our application at 
/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training



HOW TO APPLY

title: REMOTE AUTOMOTIVE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
description:
REMOTE AUTOMOTIVE VIRTUAL ASSISTANT

Lead Follow-Up • Appointment Setting • CRM • Marketplace Management

THE MISSION

Turn conversations into strong appointments, keep every lead organized, respond quickly across every channel, and help the team sell more vehicles — without sacrificing respect, accuracy, or customer trust.

"ALWAYS BE KIND, RESPECTFUL AND STRAIGHT TO THE POINT."

ROLE AT A GLANCE

•  Position: Remote Automotive Virtual Assistant

•  Starting schedule: 25 hours per week — five 5-hour shifts, Monday through Friday

•  Growth opportunity: Potential to move to 40 hours per week, or grow into a lead role helping train a second VA

•  Starting base pay: $4 per hour, plus aggressive performance bonuses (Strong Appointments can make this an easy  $10+/hour job): Base pay will go up with great consistent performances. If you can surpass 20 shown appointments for 3 months in a row I will give you a raise to $7/hour + bonuses and an additional training bonus if you wish to take on a lead role where you can have a more flexible schedule and have less stress.

•  Primary outcome: Set qualified test-drive and trade-in evaluation appointments that show up in person to meet with Andy.

•  Tools and visibility: 
, camera and screen share throughout the shift, CRM spreadsheets, phone, text,
, and online marketplaces

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a passive admin job. It is a customer-facing, performance-based role supporting an experienced automotive salesperson. You will follow up with leads, reconnect with previous customers, identify trade-in opportunities, manage marketplace activity, respond to inquiries, and turn interest into confirmed appointments.

You will start with a 25-hour training and proof period. The goal is to see what you can consistently produce at that schedule before more hours or leadership responsibility are added. Strong performance can create a path to 40–50 hours per week or to helping train a second VA under you.

WHAT YOU WILL BE EXPECTED TO DO EVERY SINGLE DAY

•  Respond quickly and professionally to new inquiries from
 Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp,
, text, and other approved lead sources.

•  Manage and update vehicle listings so information stays current, accurate, and active.

•  Monitor platform inboxes and other contact channels throughout each shift, then move every useful conversation into the CRM workflow.

•  Call follow-up leads as Andy's personal assistant and ask whether they are still in the market for a new vehicle.

•  Call equity-mining prospects, invite them to learn what their current vehicle may be worth, and determine whether they want to sell it or may consider trading it for a newer model.

•  Offer appointment times for a test drive or trade-in evaluation, confirm the appointment, send reminders, and document the result.

•  Keep customer records complete: contact information, vehicle interest, lead source, status, appointment details, touch type, call outcome, notes, and next follow-up date.

•  Log every completed touch in the Touch Log and keep the latest Touch Count and Call Outcome accurate.

•  Work urgent follow-up first so active leads do not go 72 hours without contact; sold and lost leads are excluded.

•  Communicate with Andy throughout the day in 
 and ask questions immediately whenever you are unsure.

CALL SCOPE: SET THE APPOINTMENT — DO NOT WORK THE DEAL

Your job is to create a clear next step and get the customer to the dealership. You will follow approved scripts and talking points, but you will not negotiate or discuss:

•  Vehicle pricing or discounts

•  Monthly payments

•  Financing, credit decisions, rates, or approvals

•  Trade values or promises about what a vehicle is worth

•  Any deal term that should be handled by Andy at the dealership

If a customer asks for information outside your scope, acknowledge the question, explain that Andy will handle the details, and redirect the conversation to scheduling the visit.

REQUIRED CONTACT WORKFLOW

1.  Call first.

2.  If there is no answer, leave a voi
 when possible.

3.  Send the approved follow-up text after the call.

4.  Record the attempt, call outcome, notes, and next action in the CRM before moving to the next lead.

5.  The call + voi
 when possible + text sequence counts as one full touch when the customer does not answer.

DO NOT CALL MEANS NEVER CONTACT AGAIN

Non-negotiable: If anyone asks not to be called, immediately set Call Outcome to "DNC!" The lead is removed from the active lead list and moved to the Lost Deal Log with "Do Not Call" as the reason. Do not call, text,
, message, or re-engage that person again.

DAILY OPERATING STANDARDS

•  Be logged into 
 and ready to work at the start of every scheduled shift.

•  Keep your camera on and continuously share your work screen for the entire shift. This is a monitored role, and accepting the position means agreeing to that requirement.

•  Use a reliable computer, dependable high-speed internet, a working webcam, and a clear headset or microphone.

•  Work from a quiet, professional environment suitable for customer calls.

•  Check all assigned marketplaces, messages,
, and CRM follow-ups throughout the shift — not only once.

•  Protect customer information and use it only for assigned work. Do not download, copy, share, or reuse lead data outside approved systems.

•  Follow the approved scripts, listing standards, follow-up rules, and escalation process.

•  Attend live training sessions on Andy's days off when scheduled. Apply coaching and updated talking points immediately.

•  Ask questions early. Do not guess when a customer request, CRM field, or process is unclear.

SCHEDULE AND GROWTH PATH

•  Training / proof stage: 25 hours per week across five 5-hour shifts, Monday through Friday. The specific daily work window will be agreed before hire.

•  What earns more opportunity: Consistent attendance, fast response, complete CRM records, strong appointments, coachability, and measurable results.

•  Growth path A: Increase to approximately 40 hours per week if the workload, results, and candidate's availability support it.

•  Growth path B: Remain the successful first VA and help train a second 25-hour VA as the team expands.

•  Important: More hours are an opportunity, not an automatic guarantee. Growth follows demonstrated performance and business need.

HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED

•  Speed and consistency of responses across assigned channels

•  Number and quality of appointments set

•  Appointment show rate

•  Appointments that result in vehicle sales

•  Follow-up completed before leads go stale

•  Accuracy and completeness of CRM entries and touch logs

•  Marketplace listing accuracy and inbox coverage

•  Attendance, punctuality, camera/screen-share compliance, and responsiveness in 

•  Ability to follow scripts, respect scope boundaries, and apply coaching

COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE BONUSES

The role is designed so greater results create greater earning potential. Current compensation includes:

•  $4 per hour in base pay.

•  $5 for each appointment that shows.

•  A monthly shown-appointment volume kicker using the highest tier achieved: $5 at 10 shown, $6 at 20 shown, or $10 at 30+ shown. Volume tiers do not stack with one another.

•  An additional $1bonus for every shown appointment throughout the month.

•  $50 for each shown appointment that Andy sells a car to.

•  An additional $50 for every three sold appointments in a month. Every 3 appointments sold = *$200 BONUS!

•  A $250 milestone bonus when 10 appointments set by the VA sell in a single month.

Compensation note: The written offer will confirm the final pay rate, bonus definitions, payment schedule, eligibility rules, and how results are attributed before work begins.

TEAM GOALS AND CULTURE

The monthly sales goal is no fewer than 12 car deals. The target zone is 15–20+ deals, where the team's work creates more opportunity for everyone. The mindset is simple: my goals are now our goals, and we win together by using each person's strengths to help the team earn more.

INVENIAM VIAM AUT FACIUM — I SHALL FIND A WAY, OR MAKE ONE.

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE

•  A confident communicator who can sound warm, natural, and direct on the phone.

•  A disciplined follow-up person who does not let leads disappear or tasks sit unfinished.

•  A fast, accurate typist who can talk, listen, take notes, and update a CRM without losing details.

•  Someone comfortable managing
 Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp,
, text, and similar customer channels.

•  A coachable teammate who can follow a script while sounding friendly, confident and human.

•  A self-starter who asks questions, accepts feedback without defensiveness, and implements it quickly.

•  A trustworthy professional who respects customer data and understands that "DNC!" (Do Not Call) is permanent.

•  Someone comfortable working visibly with camera and screen share on for the full shift.

•  A competitive, high-energy worker who wants earnings to grow with effort and results.

•  A person who can stay kind and respectful even when a prospect is uninterested, frustrated, or difficult.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

•  Strong spoken and written English with clear, easy-to-understand phone communication.

•  Prior experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, sales support, lead generation, customer service, or a similar role.

•  Experience using spreadsheets, web-based inboxes, messaging tools, and a CRM or comparable lead tracker.

•  A computer capable of handling calling, browser tabs, 
, CRM spreadsheets, camera, and screen sharing at the same time.

•  Stable high-speed internet, a working webcam, and a noise-controlled headset or microphone.

•  Availability for five consistent Monday–Friday shifts and scheduled live training.

•  Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow written processes exactly.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

title: Executive Assistant + Marketing & Operations Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a highly organised, proactive and culturally aware person to work directly with our founder and a small international team.



This isn't a typical virtual assistant role. We're small and hands-on, so we need someone who can do the actual work while also keeping projects, people and priorities moving.



The role crosses founder support, project management, operations, e-commerce, marketing and content. One day you might be coordinating a product launch, the next you're following up with a designer, updating Shopify, organising campaign assets, or researching something for the founder.



Over time, we want this person to learn the business deeply enough that the founder can rely on them to anticipate what needs to happen next.



What You'll Do

• Work directly with the founder to manage priorities, projects and follow-ups

• Turn conversations and ideas into clear actions, owners and deadlines

• Maintain project timelines and keep internal teams, creatives and vendors on track

• Coordinate product launches, marketing calendars and campaign assets

• Support Shopify, Klaviyo and other e-commerce activity

• Help organise social content, scheduling and basic creative needs

• Support customer experience, including orders, returns, shipping issues and enquiries

• Keep files, briefs and important information organised

• Research business needs, opportunities and cultural references

• Spot potential problems early and help find solutions



We're less interested in someone who flags that something's late, and more interested in someone who helps get it finished.



Who We're Looking For

Ideally, you have 3-6 years of professional experience across executive support, operations, project management, marketing, e-commerce, account management or something similar.



More importantly, you are:

• Highly organised, proactive and resourceful

• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

• A strong communicator who isn't afraid to follow up

• Able to manage multiple priorities without losing the details

• Good at figuring things out without needing instructions for every decision

• Quick to learn new tools and ways of working



Experience working remotely with a US or international company, or directly with a founder or executive, is a strong plus.



Cultural Fit

This matters to us.

Our world is rooted in jiu-jitsu, but it crosses into fashion, streetwear, art, design, music, photography, surfing, skateboarding, sports and global culture generally.



You don't need to know everything about these worlds, but you should naturally be curious about them and have taste of your own. You probably already follow brands, designers, artists, photographers, athletes, restaurants, publications or creative projects simply because you enjoy discovering them.



We're looking for someone who already lives somewhere within the culture, not someone trying to learn it because it's in the job description.



Tools

Experience with tools such as Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Adobe, Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, ChatGPT and project management platforms like Asana, ClickUp, Monday or Notion is helpful.



You don't need to know everything. You need to be able to learn quickly.



Working Setup

This is a full-time remote role based in the Philippines, approximately 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with 3-4 hours of regular overlap with California business hours.



How to Apply

Send us:

• A short introduction and why this role interests you

• Your resume or LinkedIn

• A brief example of a project or problem you personally took ownership of

• Five things you're currently interested in: brands, artists, designers, restaurants, books, films, athletes, creative projects or anything else, and a quick note on why



Your Instagram is optional, but feel free to share it.



No generic cover letters, and no need to overproduce anything. We want to understand how you think, communicate and what you're genuinely interested in.



Include KEEP IT MOVING somewhere in your application so we know you made it this far.



If you’re interested. Please send your CV to

title: Estimator
description:
ESTIMATOR – AUSTRALIAN CONSTRUCTION (REMOTE)



About Catalyst Constructions

Catalyst is a Brisbane-based construction company delivering commercial, residential, modular, health, community and government projects across Queensland. We build both conventional site-built and bespoke modular projects. Our work is built on precision, accountability and strong relationships with clients, subcontractors and each other.



The Role

You will price the work. You will take the tenders allocated to you and turn them into a complete, structured estimate. That means reviewing the documents, raising RFIs, measuring the plans and building the estimate to set deadlines. You will report to our Estimating Manager in Brisbane and work as part of the estimating team.



Key Responsibilities

- Review full tender sets (drawings, specifications, contract conditions, scope) and identify gaps or conflicts

- Draft RFIs and track responses and addenda through to the final estimate

- Set up each estimate in Catalyst's standard tender template and cost codes

- Produce accurate quantity take-offs from drawings, with the basis of every quantity recorded

- Build estimates line by line using Catalyst's current rates, including preliminaries priced from the program

- Separate modular and site-built scope, allowing for transport, craneage and installation

- Document the rate, source and assumption behind every allowance

- Present your estimate at the tender review meeting and answer questions on any line

- Make amendments, complete final checks and file the finalised tender to the Catalyst standard

- Prepare pricing schedules, qualifications, exclusions and submission documents for proposals

- Next step: take on trade pricing. This means issuing enquiries, levelling subcontractor quotes and maintaining the enquiry register



Requirements

- Minimum 3 years' experience as a construction estimator or quantity surveyor

- Experience pricing Australian construction projects is strongly preferred

- Strong quantity take-off skills using digital take-off software

- Solid understanding of building trades, construction sequencing and preliminaries

- Excellent written English, for RFIs, qualifications and clear reporting

- Highly organised. You meet deadlines and raise issues early rather than late

- Experience with Buildern or similar estimating software is a plus (training provided)

- Modular or prefabricated construction experience is a bonus



Working Hours

Must be available during Australian business hours (Brisbane time, AEST, UTC+10).



What We Provide

- Clear task allocation and deadlines on every tender, set at a pre-tender meeting

- Direct access to the Estimating Manager for input, rates and decisions

- Estimating software, tender templates and our cost code structure

- A long-term role with a defined progression pathway: trade pricing first, then towards Senior Estimator



How to Apply

Start your application with the words "Catalyst Estimator". Include a summary of your estimating experience, the types of projects you have priced, and the software you use. Applications without this will not be considered.

# Part-Time Business Development & Lead Generation VA

We're building our team, and I'm looking for an experienced, confident and personable **Business Development VA** who can help us find the right businesses, connect with decision-makers and book qualified appointments.



This is NOT a high-volume telemarketing or scripted call-center position.



I'm looking for someone who is comfortable researching a company, understanding why they may be a good prospect, finding the right person to speak with, and then reaching out through a combination of personalized
 and professional phone conversations.



You will be working directly with Carly (Ownership) and myself, and your primary goal will be simple:



**Find qualified businesses, start conversations, and help get the right people onto my calendar.**



## What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



* Researching and identifying potential B2B clients in Canada and the United States

* Finding business owners and key decision-makers

* Researching companies before contacting them

* Building and maintaining organized prospect lists

* Qualifying leads based on criteria we provide

* Personalizing outreach
s rather than sending generic mass
s

* Following up with prospects by
 and phone

* Making outbound cold/warm calls to North American businesses

* Having friendly, professional conversations — NOT reading a robotic sales script

* Identifying the correct contact when necessary

* Scheduling qualified appointments directly into the business owner's calendar

* Keeping accurate notes and tracking follow-ups

* Helping improve our outreach process based on what you're learning from prospects



## Experience We're Looking For



**Previous North American B2B cold-calling experience is required.**



Please apply only if you have previous experience speaking directly with businesses in **Canada and/or the United States** by phone.



We're specifically looking for someone who has experience with **business development, lead generation, appointment setting or B2B outreach**.



We are NOT looking for someone whose only experience is high-volume consumer telemarketing.



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English with clear and confident telephone communication

* Excellent written and reading comprehension in English

* Previous experience cold calling North American businesses

* Previous appointment-setting experience

* Strong internet research skills

* Experience identifying business owners and decision-makers

* Confidence speaking with receptionists, managers and business owners

* Ability to have a natural conversation rather than relying completely on a script

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills

* Strong organization and follow-up habits

* Reliable internet and a quiet, professional environment for calls

* A good-quality headset for VoIP calling



Experience with CRM systems, LinkedIn prospecting, Google Workspace, Indeed, spreadsheets and lead-generation tools is an asset.



## The Person I'm Looking For



Personality matters to me.



HIDARI is a small and growing company, and I want someone who genuinely becomes part of our team.



You should be friendly, curious, dependable and comfortable taking initiative. If you can't find the right contact, I want you to figure out another way to find them. If someone says, "That's not me, but you should talk to Sarah," I want you to follow that lead.



I'm not looking for aggressive sales tactics.



I'm looking for someone who can confidently say:



*"Hi, I'm calling from HIDARI Group here in Canada. I was doing some research on your company and was hoping you could point me in the right direction..."*



From there, you should be comfortable having a real conversation.



## Hours & Position

Because you will be calling Canadian and U.S. businesses, some of your working hours must overlap with **North American business hours (Mountain Time).**



This position will initially begin as a **3-month pilot**, with the opportunity to become a longer-term and potentially expanded role if we're a great fit and the position is producing results.



We're growing, and I would love to find someone who can grow with us.



## How to Apply



Please don't send me a generic application.



I'd genuinely like to learn a little about you.



In your application, please answer the following:

6. What tools or CRM systems have you used?

7. What do you say when a receptionist asks, **"What is this regarding?"**

8. Please include a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you'd be good at this position.



**Applications without previous North American cold-calling experience will not be considered.**



If you're confident on the phone, enjoy researching businesses, know how to get past the "gatekeeper" professionally, and love the feeling of turning a cold prospect into a booked conversation, I'd really like to hear from you.



— Kim

Team Operations Lead, HIDARI Group Ltd.

title: Senior Accountant (Australia)
description:

Works across transactional accounting through to consolidated and executive reporting.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Manage working capital, including AR aging, collections, AP payment timing, etc.

- Coordinate AP and AR activities to ensure transactional work supports month-end and reporting deadlines.

- Prepare budgets, rolling forecasts, scenario models, KPIs, dashboards, and management reports with clear financial commentary.

- Analyze the financial impact of pricing, hiring, inventory, capex, investment, and growth decisions.

- Maintain fixed assets, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, GL reconciliation, and audit support; review expenditure for capex versus opex classification.

- Support multi-currency accounting, period-end remeasurement, FX gains/losses, and group reporting.

- Reconcile billing and payment activity to customer balances, revenue, cash receipts, and the general ledger.

- Improve high-volume accounting and reconciliation processes using automation, electronic matching, Power Query, and exception-based review.

- BIG PLUS: Use AI tools for financial modelling, analysis, reporting, and visualisation while independently validating outputs.



REQUIREMENTS



- Accounting or Finance degree; CPA qualification/licence required.

title: Financial Advisory Administrative & Client Support VA
description:
Financial Advisory Administrative & Client Support Virtual Assistant



**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Employment:** Full-Time, Long-Term  

**Working Hours:** 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, aligned with Singapore business hours  

**Salary:** USD $3–$5/hour, depending on skills and experience



About the Role



I am a Singapore-based financial adviser with over 11 years of experience helping individuals and families with wealth accumulation, investments, retirement planning and insurance protection.



I'm looking for a **highly organised, reliable and proactive Virtual Assistant** to manage the day-to-day administrative operations of my financial advisory practice.



My business runs on established systems within Google Workspace, particularly Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Docs.



You will be responsible for maintaining these systems, managing administrative workflows, communicating with clients regarding policy servicing matters, and ensuring that tasks are completed accurately and on time.



This is a long-term position for someone who takes ownership of their work and enjoys keeping an organised business running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities



**1. Google Workspace & Administrative Operations**



- Manage and maintain Google Drive folders, spreadsheets, documents and administrative records.

- Update client databases, tracking sheets, task lists and operational dashboards.

- Maintain accurate and consistent information across different files and systems.

- Organise documents using established folder structures, naming conventions and workflows.

- Prepare, update and format Google Docs, Sheets, Forms and other administrative materials.

- Identify incomplete information, duplicate records, inconsistencies and missing documents.

- Track deadlines, outstanding tasks and action items.

- Suggest improvements to existing workflows and systems.



**2. Insurance & Investment Policy Administration**



- Prepare and organise policy-related documents, forms and administrative paperwork.

- Track new applications, renewals, policy servicing requests and outstanding submissions.

- Monitor administrative matters such as missing documentation, payment status and policy servicing deadlines.

- Follow up with relevant parties on outstanding administrative requirements.

- Update client records and policy tracking sheets based on verified information.

- Maintain clear records of completed actions, pending matters and follow-ups.

- Escalate unusual, incomplete or time-sensitive matters promptly.



All regulated financial advisory activities, recommendations and financial decisions remain the responsibility of the authorised financial adviser.



**3. Client Communication & Servicing Support**



- Communicate professionally with clients through approved
, messaging and other designated channels.

- Respond to routine administrative enquiries regarding their insurance and investment policies.

- Request missing documents and clarify administrative requirements.

- Provide verified updates on the progress of applications and servicing requests.

- Coordinate appointments, reminders and follow-ups.

- Maintain professional, courteous and timely communication.

- Escalate policy advice, investment questions, complaints and sensitive matters to me instead of answering independently.



**4. Workflow Management & Reporting**



- Maintain daily and weekly task trackers.

- Prioritise tasks according to urgency and deadlines.

- Follow through on pending matters until they are resolved.

- Prepare concise progress updates and highlight outstanding issues.

- Check completed work for accuracy and completeness before marking tasks as done.

- Maintain clear records of actions taken and communications sent.

- Assist with other general administrative responsibilities as needed.



Requirements



**Essential Skills**



- Strong proficiency in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Drive and Gmail.

- Comfortable with spreadsheet formulas, filters, sorting, conditional formatting and data validation.

- At least 2 years of relevant administrative, virtual assistant or operations support experience preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Confident communicating professionally with clients.

- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong organisation, time management and task prioritisation.

- Able to follow established procedures carefully and consistently.

- Proactive about deadlines, follow-ups and identifying potential problems.

- Good problem-solving ability and willingness to learn new systems.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.

- High standards of confidentiality and integrity.



**Preferred, but Not Essential**



- Previous experience supporting financial advisers, insurance agents or financial services companies.

- Familiarity with insurance and investment policy terminology.

- Experience with CRM systems, workflow automation or advanced Google Sheets.

- Experience supporting a Singapore-based business.



Industry-specific procedures and systems training will be provided.



What I Value



I'm looking for someone who is more than a data-entry assistant.



I value **accuracy, efficiency, accountability, initiative and integrity**.



You should be someone who:



- Pays attention to details without losing sight of deadlines.

- Follows instructions accurately but also thinks independently.

- Takes ownership of assigned tasks from start to completion.

- Communicates clearly when something is unclear or requires attention.

- Follows up proactively instead of waiting for repeated reminders.

- Treats confidential client information with utmost care.

- Is receptive to feedback and continuously improves.



I will provide established systems, clear expectations and guidance. In return, I expect consistency, professionalism and genuine responsibility for the work entrusted to you.



Working Arrangement



- Remote.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- Monday to Friday, with working hours aligned to Singapore business hours.

- Long-term opportunity with ongoing training.

- Salary: USD $4–$6/hour, commensurate with experience and demonstrated ability.

- Continued development and increased responsibilities based on performance.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant administrative experience.

2. Details of your experience with Google Sheets, including formulas and functions you can confidently use.

3. Any previous experience supporting insurance, investment, financial services or other client-facing businesses.

4. A short explanation of how you organise and track multiple tasks and client follow-ups.

5. A 1–2-minute video introducing yourself in English, so I can assess your communication skills.

6. Your expected hourly salary and availability.

7. Your computer specifications and internet connection details.



**Attention-to-detail test:** 

Begin your application with the words **"Accuracy Builds Trust"**.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical assessment involving Google Sheets, document organisation and professional client correspondence, using fictional client information.



I look forward to working with someone who brings professionalism, initiative and pride to their work.

title: Experienced Reddit Content Writer | AI & Multi-Niche
description:
We are looking for an experienced Reddit Content Writer with a substantial portfolio of Reddit posts and comments. You must understand Reddit culture, use AI tools effectively, and turn research and AI-assisted drafts into accurate, natural English suited to each subreddit.



TOPICS

Our content covers AI and technology, pets and animal care, home and household products, solar energy, lathes and machining, e-commerce, SaaS, and travel. You must be comfortable researching the relevant communities and their current rules across these areas. Tell us where you have direct writing experience and where you would need additional research.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Research each target subreddit before drafting: community rules, pinned guidance, permitted topics, promotional restrictions, flair requirements, and audience expectations.

- Write original Reddit posts, helpful comments, discussion prompts, and reply drafts tailored to the specific community.

- Use AI tools for research support, ideas, outlines, and drafts; independently verify facts and substantially edit the final copy.

- Adapt tone for technical, educational, practical, and conversational discussions without producing generic or repetitive text.

- Check technical claims carefully, particularly animal care, solar equipment, and machining topics, and flag anything requiring specialist review.

- Follow briefs, feedback, approval workflows, and deadlines. Deliver writing with the intended subreddit and the rules checked.

- Keep up with Reddit and subreddit rule changes and explain how they affect your writing.



REQUIREMENTS

- Extensive hands-on Reddit writing experience, demonstrated through a portfolio and specific examples of your own contribution.

- Excellent written English and strong editing, research, and fact-checking skills.

- Familiarity with AI writing tools and the ability to explain what you changed and verified after using them.

- Working knowledge of community rules in the listed sectors and the ability to identify gaps before accepting a brief.

- Reliable communication and an organized revision process.



We expect useful, authentic contributions and appropriate disclosure of commercial relationships. Do not fabricate personal experiences, reviews, or product use, plagiarize, or produce spam. This position focuses on writing and community research; account operations are handled separately.



ARRANGEMENT

Gig / freelance, initially around 10 hours per week.

USD 5 per hour.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid writing test.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with COMMUNITY-FIRST and include:

1. Three to five Reddit writing samples or anonymized examples. State the subreddit, objective, date, and exactly what you wrote.

2. Your Reddit writing experience: duration, typical monthly volume, types of posts/comments, and results you can substantiate.

3. Your strongest niches from our list, relevant subreddits, and examples of rules you must check before drafting.

4. The AI tools you use and a short explanation of your editing and fact-checking workflow.

5. One example of rewriting or cancelling content because of a subreddit rule, plus confirmation that USD 5 per hour works for you and your weekly availability.



Please do not submit confidential client material or account credentials.

title: Reddit Account Farming & Maintenance | Accounts Provided | Per-Post Commission
description:
We are looking for an experienced Reddit account farming and maintenance specialist. You will prepare our accounts for genuine, rule-compliant participation in specified subreddits, then continue participating in account maintenance and approved posting work. Initial preparation is paid per completed, accepted account. Subsequent posting work uses a commission per successfully published and accepted post. We provide the accounts, systems and written requirements.



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Reddit accounts and authorized access through our operating systems, browser environments and tools.

- The target subreddits for each account and category-specific instructions.

- A written brief covering the starting account status, required outcome, delivery deadline and evidence needed for acceptance.

You do not need to buy accounts, proxies or software. All accounts remain ours; this is not an account buying/selling role.



DELIVERY REQUIREMENTS

Assignments use a 7-10 day preparation window, with the exact requirements and deadline confirmed before each batch begins. Different categories and subreddits have different requirements. Each account is assigned one of these delivery levels:

1. Comment-ready: the account can successfully leave genuine, relevant comments in the assigned subreddits under their current rules.

2. Post-ready: the account can successfully publish permitted, relevant posts in the assigned subreddits under their current rules. Commenting eligibility alone does not meet this level.

We specify the required subreddits and delivery level in advance. There is no single universal karma target or account-age requirement for every category. Check the actual community requirements and flag any conflict with the brief or deadline before starting; do not bypass community restrictions.



ACCEPTANCE AND RECORDS

- Deliver the required outcome for the assigned account and subreddits, not just a higher karma count.

- Provide a concise activity log and relevant links or screenshots demonstrating commenting or posting eligibility. Any verification comment or post must follow our approved brief and the community rules.

- A submission button or content visible only to its author is not sufficient evidence of successful participation. Report removals, restrictions and other issues honestly.

- The account must be accessible and not banned at handover, and meet the agreed requirements for acceptance.



INITIAL ACCOUNT-PREPARATION PAYMENT AND BANNED ACCOUNTS

- Payment is per completed account that meets the agreed delivery requirements and passes acceptance. Rates are discussed privately and agreed before work starts.

- Initial account preparation is outcome-based, not hourly work. Comments and posts used to prepare or verify an account are part of that account-preparation task; ongoing posting commissions are a separate stage described below.

- If an account is banned during preparation or before acceptance, no payment is due for that account, including time already spent on it. We bear the loss of the supplied account: you do not reimburse us, pay an account-loss penalty or provide a free replacement.

- Report any ban or restriction promptly and stop work on that account pending our instructions.



ONGOING MAINTENANCE AND PER-POST COMMISSION

After initial account delivery, continued participation in account maintenance and approved posting work is part of this role; this is not a handover-only assignment.

- Maintain the assigned accounts during agreed posting batches: check status, follow the agreed community-participation plan, review subreddit rules and keep concise activity records. Report warnings, restrictions and removals promptly.

- Prepare posts from our supplied briefs or copy, make the agreed copy revisions for subreddit rules and feedback, and obtain any required approval before publishing.

- Ongoing posting work is paid through a commission for each successfully published and accepted post, separate from the initial account-preparation fee. Routine maintenance within each agreed posting batch is included in that batch's per-post arrangement. Rates are discussed privately and confirmed before work starts.

- Before each posting batch, we agree on the assigned accounts and subreddits, content requirements, maintenance duties, acceptance criteria and verification period, commission, and included revision/reposting limits. Standalone maintenance outside an agreed posting batch and changes in scope must be agreed separately; this is not an unlimited maintenance or revision obligation.

- A successful post must match the approved brief and community rules, be publicly visible in the designated subreddit, and meet the agreed acceptance criteria. Submit the post link and status record. At the agreed acceptance check, a failed submission, filtered/removed post or content visible only to its author does not qualify as an accepted post and does not earn a commission.

- Agreed copy corrections and permitted replacement posts for the same assigned post are included in that posting task. Edits, retries and replacements do not count as additional commissioned posts unless separately approved. The same task earns one commission when accepted. New briefs or work beyond the agreed limits require confirmation before proceeding.

- If a post is removed or an account is restricted, report it before taking further action. Revise or repost only with our approval and where community rules permit. Never repeatedly repost removed content or switch accounts to bypass moderator decisions, restrictions or bans.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least three years of hands-on Reddit experience, including personally managing multiple accounts and understanding subreddit commenting and posting requirements.

- Experience managing 20-30 accounts concurrently, with examples of your own work and long-term account management results.

- Ability to follow our supplied systems, keep sessions organized and maintain secure, authorized access.

- Strong English, relevant content judgment, reliable communication and accurate records.

- Up-to-date knowledge of Reddit-wide policies and the rules of assigned subreddits.



All participation must be genuine and compliant with Reddit and subreddit rules. No spam, coordinated voting, fabricated personal experiences, automated mass account creation or ban evasion. If our instructions conflict with a community rule, flag the issue rather than proceeding.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with REDDIT-OPS and briefly include:

1. Your Reddit experience, the maximum number of accounts you personally managed at once, and one real example with redacted evidence.

2. One subreddit example explaining how you check commenting eligibility and posting eligibility separately, including where you check the latest rules.

3. How you would approach a 7-10 day assignment using client-provided accounts and systems, and what you would record for acceptance.

4. Your availability, realistic batch capacity, and confirmation that you understand the initial per-accepted-account payment, banned-account terms, and subsequent per-post commission arrangement.

5. Briefly describe your experience with ongoing account maintenance, copy revisions and rule-compliant reposting after a removal.



Only share material you are authorized to show. Do not send passwords, verification codes or confidential client information.

title: URGENT: AU Tax Accountant
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

title: VIDEO EDITOR- PROFESSIONAL-(Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We’re looking for a **serious, long-term video editor** who lives and breathes short-form content.



If you’re the type of person who opens Instagram/TikTok/YouTube and instantly breaks down why a video went viral, how the hook was cut, how the subtitles were designed, and where the retention spikes are – keep reading.



If you’re just “good with CapCut” and throw random clips together, this is not for you.



WHO WE ARE

We are a fast-growing international influencer agency.

We run multiple personal brands and manage creators in fitness, lifestyle and education.

We film a lot. We post a lot. We test a lot. Your edits will be seen by millions of people if you’re good.



ROLE

Full-time Video Editor

40 hours per week (potential overtime if you’re hungry)

Long-term position with growth, bonuses and higher pay for A-players



WHAT YOU’LL BE EDITING



1. TikToks, Reels and YouTube Shorts from talking-head/podcast style videos

2. Lifestyle / travel content (gym, parties, travel, behind the scenes)

3. Clips for personal brands and creators in English-speaking markets

4. Occasionally longer YouTube edits (10–20 minutes) if you’re good at storytelling



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Take raw footage and turn it into **scroll-stopping**, high-retention clips

2. Add clean subtitles, emojis, sound effects, zooms and pattern interrupts

3. Cut powerful hooks in the first 1–3 seconds to grab attention

4. Create strong pacing and rhythm so watch-time stays high

5. Design different formats for each platform (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)

6. Organize files, name everything properly, and hit deadlines without reminders

7. Communicate clearly with the team, accept feedback, and improve fast



REQUIREMENTS



1. You already edit at a professional level (Premiere, Final Cut, or DaVinci)

2. You understand VIRAL content: hooks, retention, storytelling, pattern interrupts

3. You have a strong sense of design: fonts, spacing, colors, clean captions

4. You have a fast and stable internet connection

5. You can work PH daytime or evening with some overlap to Bangkok / EU time

6. Your English is good enough to understand context and nuance

7. You are hungry to grow, not just clock in and out



BONUS IF:



1. You’ve edited for influencers, YouTubers, creators or agencies before

2. You can also do simple thumbnails or graphic work

3. You have knowledge of what performs well in fitness, business, lifestyle niches



WHAT WE OFFER



1. Stable, long-term work with a fast-growing international team

2. Competitive salary in USD (depending on skill and experience)

3. Performance bonuses when your edits bring views, leads and sales

4. Clear feedback, constant clips to edit, and room to grow into a lead editor

5. Promotion path into Creative Director / Head Editor for the right person



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



If you skip any of these steps, your application will not be considered.



Send an application with the subject line:

**“I’m Your Video Editor – [Your Name]”**



Inside the message, include:



1. A short intro about you (2–3 sentences).

2. Links to your **3 best short-form edits** (TikTok/Reel/Shorts only).

3. Answer ALL the assessment questions below.







1. Portfolio Breakdown

 Send links to your 3 BEST short-form edits (Reels, TikToks or Shorts).

 



2. Hook Thinking

 You’re given a 45-minute talking-head video where someone explains “How I went from $0 to $100K per month.”

 Explain step-by-step how you would:

 a) Find 5 viral hooks

 b) Cut them into separate clips

 c) Turn them into 5 different Reels/TikToks designed to go viral



3. Subtitles & Design

 Show 1 example of a video where you personally did the subtitles.

 Tell me:

 – What font did you use and why?

 – How did you d
 on colors, sizing and placement?

 – How do you keep captions readable but still dynamic?



4. Storytelling

 Send 1 example of a longer edit you’ve done (YouTube, 5+ minutes).

 Explain how you structured the story (beginning, middle, end) and what changes you made to keep it engaging.



5. Speed & Workflow

 Imagine I give you:

 – 60 minutes of raw talking-head footage

 – Plus B-roll of travel/gym/lifestyle

 How many strong Reels/TikToks can you realistically deliver in 24 hours?

 Walk me through your workflow from raw files to final export.



6. Tools & Setup

 What editing software do you use and why?

 What are your computer specs?

 What is your average render time for a 60-second 4K clip?



7. Trend Knowledge

 Which editors or YouTube/TikTok channels do you study for inspiration?

 Send 3 links to creators whose editing style you admire and tell me what you like about each.



8. Communication & Feedback

 A client tells you, “I don’t like this edit,” but their feedback is very vague and not helpful.

 How do you respond, and how do you get the direction you need without being annoying?

Target Market: Australian Businesses

ABOUT THE ROLE



AP Media is a growing Australian digital marketing and technology business specialising in social media marketing, website development and AI-powered business solutions.



We are looking for a confident, motivated and results-driven Business Development Representative to help expand our client base.



Your primary responsibility will be to contact businesses across Australia, introduce AP Media's services, identify potential opportunities and generate qualified sales appointments.



We are looking for someone who is confident speaking with business owners, understands how to communicate the value of digital marketing and technology solutions, and can turn initial conversations into genuine business opportunities.



This is an outbound sales position, not a general administration or customer service role.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. OUTBOUND SALES & COLD CALLING



- Make outbound calls to Australian businesses

- Introduce AP Media and explain our services

- Speak confidently with business owners and decision-makers

- Identify businesses that could benefit from our services

- Pitch social media marketing, website development and AI receptionist solutions

- Ask relevant questions to understand each business's needs

- Handle objections professionally

- Generate qualified leads and sales opportunities

- Book appointments and consultations with interested businesses

- Follow up with potential clients who have expressed interest



2. SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING SALES



- Identify businesses that need social media marketing support

- Explain the benefits of professional content creation and social media management

- Pitch Instagram Reels,
 marketing and Meta advertising services

- Identify opportunities for ongoing monthly marketing packages

- Communicate how AP Media can improve brand visibility and generate enquiries



3. WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT SALES



- Research businesses with outdated or underperforming websites

- Identify businesses without a professional website

- Explain the benefits of modern, mobile-friendly website development

- Pitch AP Media's website design and development services

- Generate enquiries and book website consultations



4. AI RECEPTIONIST & AUTOMATION SALES



- Introduce businesses to AP Media's AI receptionist services

- Explain how AI receptionists can assist with incoming calls, enquiries and bookings

- Identify businesses that frequently receive customer calls

- Explain the potential benefits of automated call handling and lead capture

- Generate interest and book AI receptionist demonstrations

- Identify opportunities for ongoing AI automation services



5. LEAD GENERATION & FOLLOW-UPS



- Research potential business clients across Australia

- Build and maintain prospect lists

- Record calls, leads and follow-up activities in a CRM or tracking system

- Follow up with interested prospects

- Maintain accurate records of sales conversations

- Track booked appointments and qualified leads

- Provide daily sales activity reports

- Work towards agreed sales and appointment targets



ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



- Experience in outbound sales, cold calling or appointment setting

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident communicating with Australian business owners

- Strong telephone communication and sales skills

- Ability to explain services clearly and persuasively

- Confidence handling objections and rejection

- Strong organisational and follow-up skills

- Ability to work independently

- Experience using CRM systems or lead tracking software

- Reliable internet connection

- Suitable computer and professional calling equipment



BONUS SKILLS



The following skills are advantageous but not essential:



- Experience selling digital marketing services

- Knowledge of
 and Instagram advertising

- Experience selling website development services

- Familiarity with AI receptionists or AI automation

- Experience working with Australian businesses

- Experience in B2B lead generation

- Experience using ChatGPT and AI sales tools

- Experience preparing sales proposals

- Experience closing sales and negotiating contracts



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



- Confident and persuasive

- Professional and well-spoken

- Proactive and self-motivated

- Comfortable making outbound calls

- Resilient when handling rejection

- Organised and consistent with follow-ups

- Results-driven

- Interested in developing a long-term sales career



We are not looking for someone who simply makes calls to complete a daily quota.



We want someone who can have meaningful conversations, identify genuine business opportunities and help AP Media secure new clients.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The successful candidate will:



- Consistently contact suitable Australian businesses

- Generate qualified leads

- Book genuine sales appointments with decision-makers

- Maintain accurate prospect and follow-up records

- Communicate AP Media's services confidently

- Follow up on opportunities without constant supervision

- Help build a reliable pipeline of potential new clients



SALARY & COMMISSION STRUCTURE



This position offers a base salary plus commission, providing the opportunity to increase your earnings based on sales performance.



In addition to your base salary, you will earn commission for every new client you successfully bring into AP Media who signs a qualifying service agreement.



HOW COMMISSION WORKS



Receive a guaranteed base salary



Earn additional commission for every new client successfully signed, one time commission



Commission applies to new clients who enter into a qualifying paid service agreement with AP Media



Commission is calculated based on the value of the client's service package



Commission is earned once the client has signed their agreement and their first payment has been successfully received



Higher-value client contracts provide opportunities to earn higher commissions



There is no fixed limit on the number of qualifying clients you can bring into the business



COMMISSION EXAMPLE



For recurring service contracts, the proposed commission is a one-time payment equivalent to 20% of the client's first weekly service fee.



Examples:



$200 per week client = $40 commission

$300 per week client = $60 commission

$500 per week client = $100 commission

$750 per week client = $150 commission

$1,000 per week client = $200 commission



Commissions are paid in addition to your base salary and apply to qualifying new client contracts only.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



- Your CV or a short introduction

- Details of your outbound sales or cold-calling experience

- Any experience selling digital marketing or technology services

- Your availability

- Your expected weekly salary

- A short voice introduction demonstrating your spoken English and communication style



Applicants with proven experience generating qualified B2B appointments will be highly regarded.



Join AP Media and help Australian businesses grow through digital marketing, website development and AI-powered solutions.
