title: Customer Service & Operations Coordinator | Australian Air Conditioning Company | Full-Time, Remote
description:
Customer Service & Operations Coordinator | Australian Company | Full-Time, Work From Home



Company: KleenAir

Location: Remote — Philippines

Salary: Negotiable based on experience and capability

Working hours: 6:00 am–3:00 pm Philippine time / 8:00 am–5:00 pm Brisbane time



Working days — seasonal roster



This role follows a five-day working week, with working days changing seasonally:



November to April: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Wednesday and Sunday are days off.

May to October: Monday to Friday. Saturday and Sunday are days off.



You must be available for both rosters, including Saturdays from November to April.



About KleenAir



KleenAir is a family-owned Australian air conditioning and hygiene services company serving residential customers, property managers and commercial clients across South East Queensland.



We are looking for an organised, proactive and confident Customer Service & Operations Coordinator to join our office team remotely.



You will support customer enquiries, quotes, bookings, technician scheduling, service reports, real estate accounts and daily administration. Working closely with our office manager, administration team and field technicians, you will help keep jobs moving and customers informed.



This is a hands-on role requiring confident telephone communication, accurate documentation and consistent follow-through. We need someone who takes ownership of assigned work, asks sensible questions and follows tasks through to completion.



Key responsibilities



Customer enquiries, quotes and bookings



Respond professionally to enquiries by phone,
 and SMS.

Gather accurate customer, property and service information and record it in our CRM.

Prepare and send quotes using approved pricing and templates.

Follow up enquiries, outstanding quotes and approvals, clearly recording the next action.

Convert approved quotes into bookings and send confirmations and reminders.

Coordinate booking changes and communicate updates to everyone involved.

Identify opportunities for additional servicing, repairs or replacement quotes and refer them to the appropriate team member.



Scheduling and technician coordination



Assist with scheduling cleaning, servicing, repairs, installations and site visits.

Help organise practical technician runs, considering location, travel time, job duration, access and technician availability.

Ensure technicians have complete job details, access instructions, customer notes and the approved scope before attending.

Follow up missing information and communicate schedule changes promptly.

Assist with supplier enquiries, parts pricing, orders and delivery follow-up as required.



Real estate and Trade Care administration



Process work orders from property managers and real estate agencies.

Arrange tenant access and appointments while keeping property managers informed.

Follow up quotes, owner approvals and outstanding instructions before scheduling work.

Send service reports, photos and job updates to the correct authorised contact.

Keep tenant access arrangements separate from property manager approvals and account matters.

Maintain accurate property, agency and contact records.

Assist with Trade Care account follow-ups and outreach to prospective agencies.



Service reports, photos and job completion



Review completed jobs for technician notes, photos, service reports and outstanding actions.

Follow up technicians when documentation is missing, unclear or incomplete.

Upload and organise photos and reports against the correct job and customer record.

Prepare customer-facing reports from technician findings, checking accuracy, spelling and presentation.

Seek clarification when technical findings are unclear.

Send completion reports and supporting photos to customers or property managers.

Reconcile completed work and unit counts against calendar entries and CRM records.

Flag jobs requiring further work, quotes, invoicing or management attention.

Follow each assigned job through until the required administration is complete.



Customer satisfaction and repeat bookings



Make customer satisfaction calls after completed services.

Record feedback and promptly escalate complaints or unresolved concerns.

Request customer reviews in accordance with company procedures.

Contact existing customers about annual servicing and help secure repeat bookings.

Maintain follow-up lists so outstanding actions and customer requests are not forgotten.



Daily administration and reporting



Keep CRM records, calendars, spreadsheets and task lists accurate and current.

Assist with invoice preparation, payment follow-up and reconciliation checks under office procedures.

Maintain technician hours and completed-unit records for payroll review.

Check fleet activity against scheduled work and flag discrepancies for management review.

Provide daily updates covering completed tasks, bookings, outstanding items and issues requiring attention.

Support the office team with administrative tasks and process improvements.

Protect confidential customer, staff and business information.



Social media and online reputation



Prepare and schedule three approved
 posts per week.

Assist with Google Business Profile posts and review monitoring.

Use approved job photos and content while observing customer privacy requirements.

Draft professional review responses for approval where required.

What we are looking for

Relevant experience in customer service, administration, scheduling or operations support.

Strong spoken and written English, with a confident and professional telephone manner.

Confidence speaking with Australian customers, property managers, suppliers and technicians.

Excellent attention to detail when handling addresses, prices, appointments, reports and job notes.

The ability to manage several active tasks, prioritise urgent matters and follow up consistently.

Confidence using CRM systems, shared calendars, spreadsheets,
 and online calling tools.

Good judgement about what you can resolve independently and what needs escalation.

A proactive approach: you notice missing information, ask questions and take the next appropriate action.

Reliability, responsiveness and availability throughout the agreed working hours.

Willingness to learn our services, systems and operating procedures.



Experience with Australian trades businesses, real estate administration, Zoho CRM, Zoho Books or technician scheduling will be highly regarded. Air conditioning industry experience is helpful but is not essential.



Mandatory work-from-home setup



You must have a dedicated home workstation that allows you to handle customer calls, scheduling and administration professionally throughout your shift.



Your setup must include:



Dual screens: A laptop connected to an external monitor, providing two usable screens.

A reliable laptop: Capable of running our CRM, calling software,
, calendars and spreadsheets at the same time.

A dedicated workstation: A proper desk and comfortable chair in a quiet area free from distractions and background noise.

Reliable internet: A stable primary connection suitable for clear voice calls, video meetings and uploading job photos and reports.

Backup internet: A separate connection or mobile hotspot available if your primary connection fails.

Reliable electricity and backup power: Suitable backup arrangements to keep your laptop and internet connection operating during power interruptions.

A quality headset with microphone: Providing clear audio for customer calls.



This setup must be ready before you start. You must be able to remain contactable and perform your duties reliably throughout your scheduled shift.



What success looks like

Enquiries and quotes receive timely follow-up.

Bookings are accurate and technicians receive complete job information.

Reports and photos are checked and sent promptly.

Customers and property managers receive clear updates.

CRM records and calendars remain accurate.

Complaints and operational issues are escalated early.

Outstanding tasks have a clear next action and are followed through.



We value clear communication, accuracy, accountability and consistent effort. You should be able to take ownership of assigned tasks without needing repeated reminders.



How to apply



Please use the application subject line:



KleenAir – Customer Service & Operations Coordinator – [Your Name]



Include:



Your updated CV.

A short explanation of your relevant experience, particularly with Australian customers, trades businesses or property managers.

The CRM, scheduling, accounting and communication tools you have used.

A one- to two-minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you suit this role.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP and earliest available start date.

Confirmation that you can work 6:00 am–3:00 pm Philippine time and follow both seasonal rosters, including Saturdays from November to April.

A photo of your dedicated workstation showing your laptop and dual-screen setup.

Your laptop specifications, a recent internet speed test and a brief explanation of your backup internet and power arrangements.



Please also answer this practical question:



A technician marks a job as completed, but the photos are missing and the report says the system needs a repair. The property manager is asking for an update. What would you do next?



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a brief practical exercise covering customer communication, scheduling and attention to detail.

title: BDR
description:
High-Tech, AI-Enabled Commercial Lending Company Looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR)



ABOUT LENDSTRA



Lendstra is a technology-driven commercial lending company leveraging AI and automation to streamline the business financing process.



We're looking for a highly motivated, persistent, and organized Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team.



This is a follow-up-intensive sales role. You'll be responsible for re-engaging prospective borrowers, getting missed appointments back on our calendar, and following up with existing clients to collect the documents needed to move their loan applications forward.



If you're someone who loves talking to people, doesn't take no for an answer easily, and knows how to get things done, we want to hear from you.



JOB DESCRIPTION



Your primary responsibility is to ensure that no potential business opportunity falls through the cracks.



You'll work with our existing pipeline of commercial loan prospects, following up through phone calls,
s, and text messages to keep borrowers engaged and moving through the lending process.



DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Recover Missed Appointments



- Follow up with leads who missed, canceled, or never scheduled their initial consultation.

- Contact prospects through phone calls,
s, and text messages.

- Re-engage interested borrowers and get them rescheduled on our team's calendar.

- Consistently follow up with unresponsive prospects until a clear outcome is reached.



2. Collect Outstanding Loan Documents



- Follow up with borrowers after their initial onboarding call.

- Request and collect outstanding financial documents needed to process their commercial loan applications.

- Maintain consistent communication with borrowers to ensure documents are submitted promptly.

- Help borrowers understand what documents are missing and guide them through the submission process.



3. Manage Our CRM and Sales Pipeline



- Track all conversations, follow-ups, and borrower interactions in our CRM.

- Keep lead statuses, appointment information, and document collection progress up to date.

- Maintain an organized follow-up pipeline so no prospect is forgotten.



4. Communicate With Our Lending Team



- Coordinate with loan officers and other team members to keep applications moving.

- Flag unresponsive borrowers, missing information, or potential issues.

- Provide regular updates on appointments recovered, borrowers contacted, and documents collected.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



To qualify for this position, you should have:



- At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting, sales development, business development, or a similar outbound calling role.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based business owners.

- Strong phone sales and follow-up skills, including handling objections and re-engaging unresponsive prospects.

- Experience using CRM software to manage leads, track conversations, and schedule follow-ups.

- Comfort using multiple communication channels, including phone,
, and SMS.



SOFT SKILLS



We're looking for someone who is:



- Persistent and resilient: You're comfortable following up multiple times and don't get discouraged when prospects don't respond.

- Highly organized: You can manage dozens of ongoing conversations without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

- Proactive and self-motivated: You take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

- Confident and personable: You know how to build rapport with business owners and make conversations feel natural.

- Detail-oriented: You understand the importance of accurate records, document tracking, and timely follow-ups.



BASIC SKILLS



You should be comfortable using:



- Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Calendar)

- CRM software

- Online scheduling tools such as Calendly

- Phone dialers,
, and SMS communication platforms

- Slack or similar team communication tools

- AI-powered productivity tools



DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE (NOT REQUIRED)



The following would be a plus:



- Previous experience in commercial lending, business financing, or financial services.

- Experience recovering no-shows, handling objections, or reactivating old leads.

- Experience collecting financial documents or assisting clients through an application process.



CAREER GROWTH



Lendstra is building a technology-driven commercial lending operation, and we're looking for people who want to grow with us.



As the company expands, strong performers may have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities, help improve our sales processes, and eventually move into senior business development or team leadership positions.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit your resume along with a short introduction video describing your experience with outbound calling, appointment setting, or sales follow-up.



In your application, please answer these three questions:



1. How many outbound calls were you typically making per day in your previous role?

2. How would you approach a prospect who missed their appointment and hasn't responded to your last three calls?

3. What experience do you have managing a CRM or following up with customers to collect outstanding information?



We're looking for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, following through consistently, and taking ownership of results.



Company: Lendstra

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.



You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.



Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.



How it works

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.



Requirements

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)



Nice to have

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments



Terms

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

title: New Zealand focused Traffic Management Planner | Morning Shift
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and safety-focused Traffic Management Planner to support the development and documentation of robust traffic management strategies for civil and infrastructure projects. 



This role is responsible for bridging the gap between permanent engineering designs and temporary site safety, ensuring all Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) are meticulously prepared, risk-assessed, and compliant with relevant industry safety standards. 



The successful candidate will play a critical role in minimising on-site hazards, protecting both the workforce and the public, and supporting the seamless execution of traffic management operations across multiple projects. 



Responsibilities 

Traffic Management Planning 

Author and develop comprehensive Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) that effectively translate permanent road design principles into safe and compliant temporary traffic management strategies. 



Risk Assessment and Mitigation 

Identify site hazards and utilise 5x5 risk matrices to evaluate residual risks, ensuring all planning documentation satisfies strict safety and compliance requirements. 



Compliance Management 

Maintain alignment with ISO principles and health and safety frameworks to ensure all documentation adheres to legislative and regulatory standards. 



Technical Software Utilisation 

Use specialised traffic management and CAD-based software to produce accurate traffic routing plans, site layouts, and operational diagrams. 



Stakeholder Collaboration 

Work closely with engineering, operations, and project teams to ensure the practicality and operational feasibility of traffic management plans, updating documentation as project requirements evolve. 



Requirements 

Proven experience in Traffic Management Planning, TMP design, civil roading, traffic engineering, construction planning, or a related field. 

At least 1 year of hands-on TMP design experience in New Zealand. 

Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, including hazard identification, 5x5 risk matrices, and residual risk evaluation. 

Strong familiarity with ISO principles or structured health and safety management systems. 

Ability to apply permanent road design principles within temporary traffic management environments. 

Strong computer literacy with the ability to quickly learn specialised technical planning software. 

High attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate, audit-ready technical documentation. 

Strong written and verbal English communication skills aligned with Australian professional standards. 

Experience with CAD or AutoCAD is highly advantageous, though not essential. 



Software Proficiency 

Traffic Management Software: Rapid Plan or equivalent CAD-based traffic management platforms 

Design Software: AutoCAD or standard CAD software (preferred) 

Productivity Tools: Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and Outlook 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Geodetic Engineering, or a related field. 

Relevant Associate Degree or Advanced Diploma in Engineering Technology will also be considered. 



Time Zone: New Zealand Business Hours 

Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

Responsibilities 

Accounts Payable Management 

Process accounts payable transactions accurately and timely, including invoice verification, coding, and data entry into the Xero accounting system. 

Perform credit card reconciliation to ensure all transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled with corresponding invoices or receipts. 

Review and reconcile vendor statements, resolving any discrepancies or outstanding issues with payments. 

Prepare and process payment runs, including electronic transfers, checks, and ACH payments, according to company policies and payment terms.

Accounts Receivable Management

Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines. 

Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, for interacting with vendors, customers, and internal stakeholders. 

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaborate effectively within a team environment. 

Knowledge of accounting principles, GAAP, and relevant regulatory requirements governing accounts payable and accounts receivable functions. 

Problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve issues efficiently. 

Proficient in Excel; Spreadsheets 



Desirable 

Experience in handling complex financial records and conducting detailed financial analysis. 



Software 

Xero accounting software expertise is required.

Education

title: WordPress & Marketing Systems VA — Australian Law Firm (Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a boutique Australian law firm based in Sydney, with offices in Beecroft and the Blue Mountains. We help people with wills and estates, property and conveyancing, and business law. 

We are looking for someone to take ownership of the technical side of our marketing — the website, the
 systems, and the automations behind them. This is a long-term part-time role, commencing with more hours on a backlog project. If it works well, hours and scope could grow.



WHAT THE FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE 

We have just opened a second office and we have a clear backlog of work ready for you — a booking system to check, location pages to build out, technical SEO to fix, and a content pipeline to get running. You will not be sitting waiting for tasks.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Website (WordPress)

1. Practical improvements to our existing WordPress site: such as clearer call-to-action buttons, additional book-an-appointment buttons, possibly more modern page layouts

2. Publish blog articles to our blog grid, formatted properly with images and internal links for SEO. Develop further so blogs can be sorted by category. 

3. Enhance the location pages for our two offices and the suburbs we service 

4. Check the set up of our appointment booking using Microsoft Bookings (we are on Microsoft 365) — multiple staff, two office locations, synced to Outlook calendars. Add a booking button to the site header and a sticky call/book bar on mobile

5. Build proper Contact, Our Team and individual solicitor pages (our navigation currently uses homepage anchors)

6. Publishing lead magnets: such as a downloadable guide in return for
 addresses.

7. On-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal linking, schema where relevant

8. Add structured data (schema) to the site: Legal Service for both office locations, Person for each solicitor, FAQ Page on service pages, and Aggregate Rating for our Google reviews

9. Audit our Google Tag Manager and Analytics setup — we currently have two containers firing and suspect we are double-counting

10. Build and maintain Google Business Profiles for both offices, including posts, photos and Q&A

11. Fix legacy issues as you find them: internal links using http instead of https, mixed-content images, outdated footer content, duplicated page sections

12. Keep plugins, backups and page speed in order

13. General maintenance. You audit. We do not want to be the ones who discover a broken contact link six months from now. We expect you to check things, find problems, and raise them



 and automation

1. Set up automated
 nurture sequences for new leads in MailChimp. You don’t necessarily need to write the copy – we can arrange for someone else to do that if it isn’t your skillset.

2. Build forms and landing pages for lead magnets, and connect them to the right list and sequence

3. Set up and maintain tracking so we can see what is actually working



Other

1. Connect our Instagram account to our
 page so content posts to both

2. Upload webinar recordings to our YouTube channel with titles, descriptions and thumbnails

3. General "make this work properly" tasks as they come up

4. Might possibly assist with Google ads in time, but this is not priority just now



OUR SETUP

• WordPress, built with Themify, hosted on Siteground

• SEO plugin: YOAST. Forms: Themify

• Microsoft 365 for
 and calendars. MailChimp for marketing
. Canva for graphics

• Tell us honestly how comfortable you are with our page builder. This is critical. We would rather know upfront than find out in week three



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

• Demonstrated hands-on WordPress experience — you can edit layouts, fix things that break, and make a page look good without a developer

• Practical on-page SEO knowledge 

• Experience building
 automations in MailChimp, or a very close equivalent you can show us

• Good written English. You will not be writing our marketing copy, but you will be writing to us every day

• You tell us when something is a bad idea, rather than just doing it, and make suggestions as to what we might need

• Reliable. We would rather have someone steady for three years than someone brilliant for three months

• You will have access to our website,
 systems and marketing tools. You will not have access to client files or matters, but you will sign a confidentiality agreement before we start. We are a law firm and we take this seriously

• Nice to have: Google Analytics/Search Console, Canva, basic HTML/CSS, experience with professional services or legal clients.



HOURS 

• Phase 1: approximately 80–100 hours over the first 8 weeks (around 12–15 hours per week) to clear a defined backlog.

• Phase 2: ongoing maintenance and publishing at around 10 hours per week.

• Some overlap with Sydney business hours preferred

• You must remain contactable, and in regular contact

• ₱425–600/hr, paid in AUD



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that ignore these steps will not be read.

1. Put "WORDPRESS - BEECROFT" in your subject line.

2. Send us your CV so we can learn more about you and your skills and experience

3. Send us links to two WordPress sites you have worked on, and tell us in one or two sentences what you specifically did on each.

4. Go to 
 and spend ten minutes on it. Tell us the three things you would fix first and why. Be specific and be blunt — we are not looking for compliments. 

5. Tell us what
 platforms you have built automations in.

6. Tell us your available hours in Sydney & Philippine time.

title: Hiring: Quality Analyst - Intake Specialist for a US Company!
description:
About Us



Attorney Assistant is a staffing solutions and virtual assistant company for law firms. We recruit, vet, and train full-time virtual staff who embed into each firm’s team, systems, and daily workflow, handling intake, follow-up, case support, and back office.



Frontline is our 24/7 live intake team. Our specialists answer calls for law firms day and night, qualify leads, and work to sign cases. This is where you will work. As a QA Analyst on Frontline, you will review calls, score performance, and give the feedback that helps our team get better every week. We run QA on every call, and we hold ourselves to results and signed cases.

We are looking for detail-oriented, accountable professionals who care about getting it right and want to help law firms stop losing cases to missed calls and slow follow-up. If you want to grow with a company that rescues law firms from chaos with elite teams and AI, we would like to meet you.potential clients, qualify leads, and help law firms turn inquiries into signed cases.



Role Overview

We are seeking a Quality Analyst (QA) – Intake Specialist to join our remote team. This role is essential to maintaining and improving the quality, accuracy, and efficiency of our intake operations.

The successful candidate will monitor and evaluate intake calls in both Spanish and English, assess case eligibility determinations, and ensure that client interactions meet AA and EOL’s standards for professionalism, accuracy, empathy, and compliance.

The QA will also provide constructive feedback, conduct performance analyses, identify training opportunities, and recommend process improvements to enhance team performance and client satisfaction.



Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), with occasional rotating shifts depending on business needs. Candidates must be available to work U.S. business hours and have a reliable home-based work setup.



Core Responsibilities:

1. Quality Monitoring & Evaluation

Monitor and evaluate intake calls,
s, and case documentation in both Spanish and English to ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and service standards.

Review case eligibility determinations to ensure Intake Specialists accurately assess potential personal injury and workers’ compensation cases based on EOL’s established criteria.

Develop, maintain, and utilize quality assurance scorecards to measure performance, identify recurring issues, and track improvement over time.

Handle intake calls as needed to support client inquiries and maintain operational coverage.

Identify trends in call quality, documentation accuracy, communication, and case assessment.



2. Performance Analysis & Coaching

Provide regular, constructive feedback and coaching to Intake Specialists to improve communication, case assessments, adherence to intake scripts, and overall client experience in both Spanish and English.

Identify performance gaps and training needs, collaborating with team leaders and management to implement targeted coaching and professional development initiatives.

Prepare quality reports and performance summaries highlighting individual and team performance, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.

Recognize high-performing team members and share best practices to strengthen overall team effectiveness.

Monitor the effectiveness of coaching initiatives and follow up to ensure measurable and sustained improvement.



3. Process Improvement & Compliance

Ensure Intake Specialists follow established company policies, intake procedures, legal and ethical guidelines, and applicable confidentiality requirements.

Collaborate with management to develop and improve quality assurance standards, bilingual intake scripts, evaluation criteria, and training materials.

Proactively identify operational gaps, recurring errors, and process inefficiencies, and recommend practical solutions.

Support compliance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.

Maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive client information while working remotely.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance intake accuracy, efficiency, and client satisfaction.

Fluency in both Spanish and English, spoken and written, is required.

Proven experience as a Quality Analyst, Quality Assurance Specialist, Intake Supervisor, or Customer Service QA professional in a legal, healthcare, or service-oriented industry.

Strong understanding of quality assurance processes, client interactions, call evaluation, and performance monitoring.

Experience reviewing case eligibility assessments, intake documentation, or similar decision-making processes is highly desirable.

Excellent listening, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify performance gaps and provide actionable feedback.

Proficiency in CRM and case management software; Salesforce experience is preferred.

Familiarity with call monitoring tools, quality assurance scorecards, reporting systems, and data analysis platforms.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coach and train team members effectively.

High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple evaluations, reports, and coaching sessions simultaneously.

Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote team environment.

Nice to Have

Previous experience working in a law firm, legal intake department, or personal injury and workers’ compensation practice.

Background in call center quality assurance, process optimization, training and development, or performance management.

Familiarity with Pennsylvania personal injury and workers’ compensation laws and intake requirements.

Experience developing QA scorecards, performance dashboards, and quality improvement initiatives.

Experience working with distributed or remote teams.

title: Experienced Amazon Wholesale Product Researcher / Catalog Analyst
description:
Amazon Wholesale Catalog Analyst / Product Researcher — Part Time



Pay: $3–7 USD/hour based on demonstrated skills, plus performance bonuses. Higher rates may be considered based on proven performance and a strong track record.

Hours: Initially around 10 hours/week. Higher guaranteed hours may be negotiated based on experience and scope.

Location: Remote, Philippines.



ABOUT JKB WHOLESALE



JKB Wholesale is a Texas-based business sourcing wholesale products for resale on Amazon in the United States. We’re looking for an experienced researcher who can independently analyze supplier catalogs and provide accurate, well-supported recommendations.



We value honest communication, careful research and a respectful working relationship. Hours and responsibilities may increase as the business grows and sufficient work becomes available.



THE ROLE



Your initial focus will be screening supplier price lists, verifying promising products and maintaining an organized research spreadsheet. We provide our criteria, reporting format and approval process. You should already understand Amazon wholesale research.



Main responsibilities:

• Efficiently screen large supplier catalogs using bulk tools and spreadsheets, followed by manual verification.

• Match supplier products to Amazon listings, verifying UPC, size, variation, pack count and case quantities.

• Review Keepa history, estimated demand, Buy Box behavior, competition and Amazon presence.

• Calculate both FBA and FBM profitability, including product cost, freight, postage, packaging, prep and relevant Amazon fees.

• Flag supplier minimums, marketplace restrictions, expiration concerns and unresolved questions.

• Record supporting links, calculations, recommendations and reasons for rejection.



Accurate rejection of unsuitable products is valuable. We do not require a guaranteed number of profitable leads.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Hands-on U.S. Amazon wholesale catalog analysis.

• Experience using a bulk catalog screening tool, such as ScanUnlimited, Seller Assistant’s Price List Analyzer or a comparable tool.

• Strong Keepa analysis and accurate product matching.

• Understanding of FBA/FBM economics and case-to-sellable-unit calculations.

• Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, filtering and lookups.

• Ability to work independently and explain your decisions.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



• Finding and qualifying local/regional wholesalers, national distributors and brands that accept Amazon-only retailers.

• Supplier outreach and organized follow-up.

• SellerAmp, AZInsight, SmartScout or similar research tools.

• Understanding of MAP policies, brand restrictions, sourcing documentation and Amazon eligibility checks.



COMMUNICATION AND WORK HABITS



• Clear written English and attention to detail.

• Reliable progress updates and agreed deadlines.

• Accurate time records showing tasks completed and time spent.

• Willingness to flag uncertainty, ask necessary questions and report mistakes promptly.

• Reliable computer and internet connection.



Research tools and authorized access will be agreed before starting. Please distinguish tools you have used from subscriptions you currently own or are authorized to use.



CONFIDENTIALITY AND EXCLUSIVITY



Our private supplier information, pricing, catalogs, curated leads and research must not be shared, sold, published or reused for yourself or other clients. No subcontracting or unauthorized sharing of access.



Written confidentiality terms are required before private materials are provided.



Exclusivity is preferred but not required. Other work must not compromise confidentiality, create conflicts or involve billing multiple clients for the same working time. Any exclusive arrangement, compensation, guaranteed hours and start date must be agreed in writing.



All purchases and supplier commitments require owner approval.



PAY AND SELECTION



• $3–6 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated ability, plus performance bonuses.

• Higher rates may be considered based on proven performance and a strong track record.

• Brief interview followed by a paid assessment of up to four hours.

• A paid 20–30-minute walkthrough to explain your work.

• Assessment and walkthrough rates agreed beforehand; payment does not depend on being hired.

• Weekly payment initially.

• Performance bonus criteria agreed in writing.

• Potential for increased hours as performance, business growth and available work justify.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with “WHOLESALE ANALYST” and include:



1. Your relevant U.S. wholesale catalog experience, including what you personally handled.

2. Bulk screening tools you have used and approximate catalog sizes.

3. Your requested hourly rate, weekly availability and current commitments.

4. Whether you operate an Amazon business, sell leads or work through an agency or subcontractors.

5. Which research subscriptions you currently own or are authorized to use.

6. A short explanation of how you detect pack-count mismatches and evaluate an unstable Keepa chart.



An authorized, redacted sample is welcome but optional. Do not submit confidential client work or assume removing supplier names makes it shareable. Applicants without a shareable sample can demonstrate their skills using our assessment materials.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and paid assessment. References may be requested with your permission.

🕒 Work on AEST hours. Be available during Australian business hours. Mac users preferred.



🧰 What you bring

• Minimum 5 years of professional video editing experience in a corporate, documentary or narrative environment (not purely social media or template-based editing).

1. Social Media Management & Content Creation

Help us build an engaging, professional, and consistent online presence across our brands.

Responsibilities include:

- Create visually appealing social media posts, stories, reels, and other marketing content.

- Develop engaging captions that reflect each brand's unique personality and audience.

- Schedule and publish content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.

- Organize content calendars and plan posts in advance.

- Research trending content, creative ideas, and opportunities to improve engagement.

- Repurpose existing photography, video, testimonials, and other marketing materials into fresh content.

- Monitor comments and messages and assist with community engagement.

- Maintain brand consistency across visual designs, messaging, and marketing materials.

- Track basic social media performance and suggest opportunities for improvement.



We're looking for someone with a creative eye who understands what makes a social media post attractive, engaging, and professional—not someone who simply fills a posting schedule.



2. Client Engagement & Relationship Building

Help us strengthen relationships with existing clients while creating opportunities to connect with new ones.



Responsibilities include:

- Assist with personalized follow-ups to existing clients.

- Help maintain regular communication with realtors, businesses, and other professional contacts.

- Research prospective clients and identify opportunities for new business.

- Prepare thoughtful, professional outreach messages and follow-up communications.

- Maintain and update contact lists and client relationship records.

- Monitor and assist with responding to social media messages and inquiries.

- Help develop creative ways to stay connected with clients and encourage repeat business.

- Track outreach activities, responses, and follow-up opportunities.

- Support client appreciation initiatives, promotional campaigns, and relationship-building activities.



We value genuine relationships over aggressive sales tactics. We're looking for someone who can communicate warmly, professionally, and naturally while representing our business.



3. Research & Business Development Support

Help us make informed decisions and identify new opportunities.



Responsibilities include:

- Research potential clients, business partners, and networking opportunities.

- Research competitors, industry trends, marketing strategies, and emerging tools.

- Identify opportunities to improve our services and customer experience.

- Compare software, subscriptions, products, and services.

- Gather information and prepare organized summaries or recommendations.

- Research local events, business organizations, and promotional opportunities.

- Assist with special projects and new business initiatives.



We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to be curious, resourceful, and willing to find answers.



4. Executive & Personal Assistant Support

Help the business owner stay organized, focused, and productive.



Responsibilities may include:

- Manage calendars, appointments, reminders, and scheduling.

- Organize
s, prioritize messages, and draft professional responses.

- Maintain task lists, track deadlines, and follow up on outstanding items.

- Prepare documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and meeting notes.

- Coordinate meetings and assist with meeting preparation.

- Organize digital files and maintain accurate records.

- Help coordinate communications with team members, clients, and vendors.

- Assist with travel planning, reservations, purchasing research, and other approved administrative tasks.

- Support occasional personal administrative requests, where appropriate and mutually agreed upon.

- Identify tasks that can be handled independently to free up the business owner's time.



Our ideal candidate doesn't just wait for instructions. They notice what needs attention, ask thoughtful questions, and look for ways to make the business run more smoothly.



5. General Administration & Special Projects



As our business continues to grow, your responsibilities may evolve.



You may also assist with:

- Developing and organizing marketing campaigns.

- Updating website content and basic business information.

- Creating promotional materials, newsletters, and client communications.

- Maintaining business databases and administrative systems.

- Coordinating tasks with other team members.

- Assisting with new initiatives, process improvements, and occasional special projects.

- We value flexibility and welcome team members who enjoy learning new skills and taking on new challenges.



Who We're Looking For



Essential Qualifications



1. Excellent English Communication



You must be highly proficient in both written and spoken English.



You should be comfortable writing professional
s, engaging social media captions, and communicating directly with Canadian clients when required.



Your writing should sound natural, personable, and professional—not overly formal, generic, or obviously AI-generated.



2. Creativity & Strong Visual Judgment



You have a natural eye for attractive, professional-looking content.



You understand the importance of layout, spacing, typography, colours, image selection, and overall presentation.



You enjoy creating content that looks polished and captures attention.



3. Exceptional Attention to Detail



You notice spelling mistakes, formatting inconsistencies, incorrect information, and small issues that others might overlook.



You take pride in delivering work that is accurate and ready to use.



4. Initiative & Independent Thinking



You can work independently, solve problems, and make thoughtful recommendations.



You're comfortable asking questions when something is unclear, but you also enjoy figuring things out.



5. Strong Organization & Time Management



You can manage multiple responsibilities, prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and keep information organized.



6. Willingness to Learn & Grow



You don't need to know our industry or every platform we use.



We're looking for someone who is enthusiastic about learning, welcomes constructive feedback, and wants to develop new skills as the company grows.



7. Professionalism & Dependability



You understand the importance of confidentiality, reliability, honesty, and respectful communication.



You follow through on commitments and communicate proactively when challenges arise.



8. Comfortable Using Technology



You should be confident using computers, online tools, social media platforms, and cloud-based applications.



You don't need to be an expert in every system, but you should be comfortable learning new technology.



9. Strong Internet & Computer Equipment



You must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a suitable environment for remote work and occasional video calls.



Skills That Would Be an Advantage



Experience with any of the following would be helpful, but is not required:



Canva or similar graphic design tools.



Instagram,
, and LinkedIn business accounts.



Meta Business Suite or social media scheduling platforms.



Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.



ChatGPT or other AI-assisted productivity tools.



Customer relationship management (CRM) systems.



 marketing platforms.



Basic video editing for social media reels.



Administrative or executive assistant responsibilities.



Client outreach, marketing, or business development.



Previous experience supporting entrepreneurs, small businesses, or North American clients would be an asset.



Experience in photography, videography, weddings, or real estate is not required.



Working Hours & Availability



Location: Remote – Philippines only.



Position: Part-time initially, with opportunities for increased hours and responsibilities.



Schedule: Applicants must have consistent availability throughout the Monday-to-Friday workweek.



While the schedule will offer flexibility, regular weekday availability is important for communication, client engagement, and time-sensitive administrative tasks.



Some overlap with Canadian Eastern Time business hours will be required for meetings, collaboration, and occasional urgent requests.



We're looking for someone who is comfortable starting with a manageable workload and gradually increasing their hours as they become familiar with our businesses, responsibilities, and systems.



Our goal is to build a long-term working relationship with someone who wants to grow alongside the company.



What You Can Expect From Us



A friendly, respectful, and collaborative working environment.



Direct communication with the business owner.



Training and guidance on our systems, services, and processes.



Opportunities to contribute ideas and influence how we grow.



A variety of interesting and creative responsibilities.



Constructive feedback and opportunities for professional development.



Increasing responsibility and potential for additional hours as the business expands.



We believe great team members should feel valued, supported, and trusted.



How to Apply



We want to get to know the person behind the résumé!



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction



Tell us about yourself, your previous experience, and why this position interests you.



2. Your experience and skills



Tell us about your experience with social media, administration, client communication, or other relevant responsibilities.



3. Examples of your creative work



Share two or three examples of social media posts, graphics, captions, or other creative projects you've completed. Personal projects are welcome!



4. A short introduction video (approximately 1–2 minutes)



Introduce yourself, tell us why you'd be a great fit for our team, and share something you enjoy doing outside of work.



This doesn't need to be professionally produced. We're simply interested in getting a sense of your personality, communication style, and enthusiasm.



5. Your availability and expected hourly rate



Please include your preferred working hours, availability during the week, expected hourly compensation, and whether you'd be interested in increasing your hours over time.



Ready to Grow With Us?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest résumé or the most years of experience.



We're looking for someone who is creative, dependable, curious, organized, and excited to become an important part of our team.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Business Development & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
We're a growing creative and digital agency looking for a proactive, results-driven Virtual Assistant who can help us generate leads, convert prospects into clients, and grow our business.

Your Primary Responsibilities (60% of the time):

, social media outreach, and other effective channels. We are NOT looking for someone who relies solely on LinkedIn.

- CRM &
 Marketing: Use tools like GoHighLevel to manage leads, automate follow-ups, execute
 campaigns, and track results.

 sequences, and other marketing content.

Compensation:

What we want to build



A practical engineering estimation tool where our team can enter:



Tank diameter and height



Wind region and design wind loads



Seismic requirements



Steel grades (G350 and G450)



Panel dimensions and configuration



Other relevant structural design parameters



The system should calculate indicative panel thicknesses for different tank courses and estimate material quantities for tender pricing.



We want to explore using finite element analysis (FEA), Python automation, parametric modelling and AI to automate the process rather than manually engineering every tank configuration.



We may have access to existing Strand7 and SPACE GASS models, but applicants must also be comfortable developing the system from scratch if required.



Required skills



Structural engineering and finite element analysis



Python programming and automation



Parametric structural modelling



Steel plate design, buckling and structural optimisation



Experience with FEA software such as Strand7, SPACE GASS, ANSYS, Abaqus or similar



Ability to automate multiple engineering scenarios and extract results into Excel or a simple software interface



Experience with Australian structural design standards and bolted steel water tanks would be highly regarded.



Project approach



We are not expecting a fully certified engineering design system immediately.



The priority is to develop a preliminary estimating tool that provides reasonably reliable results for our common tank configurations.



We would like to start with a small paid trial to demonstrate the approach, followed by further development if successful.



The system should be scalable so we can continue improving the accuracy and expanding the range of tank configurations over time.



Final structural designs will remain subject to engineering verification.



How to apply



Please message me directly on WhatsApp:




In your message, please include:



Your relevant structural engineering and FEA experience.



Any previous projects involving Python automation, parametric modelling or structural optimisation.



How you would approach developing this tool, including starting from scratch.



Your estimated timeframe and cost for an initial working prototype.



Examples of similar work you have completed.



We are looking for someone technically capable who can help us develop a practical solution, not just undertake individual structural calculations.



There is potential for ongoing engineering and software development work with our Australian business.

title: HVAC Technical Operations Coordinator – Remote Role for Australian Air Conditioning Company
description:
Employment Type



Full-time remote role

Australian business hours required

Long-term position for the right person



Company Overview



KleenAir is a growing South East Queensland air conditioning, HVAC hygiene, servicing, repairs, maintenance and installation company. We work with homeowners, tenants, property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality businesses and facilities managers across Brisbane, Ipswich, Logan, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba and surrounding areas.



We are looking for a technically minded HVAC operations person who can support our field technicians, office team and customers by preparing professional reports, diagnosis summaries, quotes, proposals, supplier orders, parts sourcing, technician follow-ups and job completion checks.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. We need someone with real HVAC, air conditioning or refrigeration knowledge who understands how service jobs operate, how technicians work in the field, how parts and equipment are sourced, and how to communicate technical information clearly.



About the Role



You will be a key support person between our technicians, office team, suppliers and customers.



Your role will include preparing detailed service reports, fault diagnosis reports, quotes and proposals based on technician notes, photos and findings. You will also assist with supplier calls, system orders, replacement parts sourcing, delivery coordination, stock pick-up arrangements, technician job completion checks, time logs, vehicle fleet monitoring and general technical operations support.



You must be comfortable understanding air conditioning systems, technical faults, technician notes, supplier information, parts availability, installation requirements and customer-facing recommendations.



We need someone organised, accurate, reliable and technically capable.



Key Responsibilities

1. Service Reports, Diagnosis Reports & Proposals



Prepare professional service reports based on technician notes, job photos, videos and field findings.



Prepare detailed fault diagnosis reports for split systems, ducted systems and commercial air conditioning equipment.



Write clear recommendations for repairs, maintenance, replacements or further investigation.



Prepare customer quotes for air conditioning cleaning, servicing, repairs, parts replacement and installation-related work.



Prepare proposals for property managers, real estate agencies, commercial clients, hospitality clients and facilities managers.



Review technician photos and identify what should be included in reports.



Convert rough technician notes into polished, professional and easy-to-understand language.



Prepare before-and-after summaries for HVAC hygiene jobs.



Prepare replacement recommendations where repairs are uneconomical due to system age, parts availability or repair cost.



Ensure reports are technically accurate, well-structured and suitable for homeowners, landlords, property managers and commercial clients.



2. Supplier Communication & Parts Sourcing



Call and
 suppliers to check stock availability, pricing and lead times.



Source replacement parts for air conditioning and HVAC repair jobs.



Identify and request pricing for components such as PCBs, fan motors, compressors, capacitors, sensors, thermistors, drain pumps, zone motors, dampers, filters and other HVAC parts.



Assist with organising air conditioning system orders for installations and replacements.



Arrange supplier deliveries to job sites, office, warehouse or technician pick-up locations.



Coordinate stock pick-ups and make sure technicians know where and when parts or systems are available.



Follow up suppliers when pricing, parts confirmations or delivery updates are delayed.



Keep the office team updated on parts availability, delays and expected delivery times.



Maintain clear records of supplier pricing, purchase details, expected delivery dates and job allocation.



3. Technician Job Coordination & Quality Follow-Up



Monitor scheduled jobs and check that technicians are completing work as per the job scope.



Review job notes, photos and completion details to ensure work has been properly documented.



Follow up technicians when information is missing, unclear or incomplete.



Check whether required photos have been uploaded before reports are prepared.



Help ensure technicians are completing jobs to company quality standards.



Assist the office team in identifying jobs that need follow-up, return visits, quoting or escalation.



Help make sure customers and property managers receive accurate updates after technical jobs.



Support technicians with job details, supplier information, parts updates and documentation requirements.



4. Time Logs, Job Tracking & Fleet Monitoring



Maintain technician time logs based on job schedules, field updates and vehicle tracking information.



Check technician start times, finish times, travel time and job completion times where required.



Assist with monitoring technician productivity and daily job progress.



Review vehicle fleet movements where required to support time log accuracy and job tracking.



Identify delays, gaps or inconsistencies between scheduled works, technician updates and actual job progress.



Help the management team understand technician workload, daily output and job completion status.



Support scheduling improvements by identifying where jobs are taking longer than expected or where routing/logistics can be improved.



5. General Operations Support



Work closely with the office team, technicians and management to keep jobs moving smoothly.



Help keep job records, reports, quotes and supplier updates organised.



Assist with internal process improvement around technical reporting, quoting, stock control and technician coordination.



Follow company templates, wording, quality standards and reporting processes.



Ask clear questions when technician notes or supplier details are incomplete.



Help maintain consistency across reports, quotes, proposals and customer communication.



Required Experience



Strong background in HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration, mechanical services, building services or HVAC operations.



Previous experience as an HVAC technician, refrigeration technician, HVAC service coordinator, HVAC admin support, dispatcher, estimator, technical report writer, maintenance coordinator, parts coordinator or similar.



Strong understanding of split systems and ducted air conditioning systems.



Ability to understand common AC faults and explain them professionally.



Ability to read technician notes and photos and turn them into clear customer-facing reports.



Experience dealing with suppliers, checking parts availability or coordinating equipment orders.



Strong written and spoken English.



High attention to detail.



Ability to work independently without needing constant supervision.



Good computer skills and ability to work with online systems, cloud documents, CRM software, job management tools and spreadsheets.



Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment.



Highly Valued Skills



Experience working with an Australian, New Zealand, UK, US or similar HVAC company.



Knowledge of Australian air conditioning terminology, supplier processes and customer expectations.



Experience preparing quotes, diagnosis reports, maintenance reports, repair proposals or insurance-style reports.



Experience coordinating technicians, job schedules, parts, stock, deliveries or supplier orders.



Understanding of property management workflows.



Knowledge of HVAC hygiene, mould contamination, coil cleaning, ducted systems, air movement and indoor air quality.



Ability to use AI tools carefully to improve writing while still applying real HVAC knowledge.



Experience with ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus, FieldPulse, Jobber, ServiceTitan, 
, CRMs, Google Workspace or similar systems.



Technical Knowledge We Are Looking For



You should be comfortable understanding and writing about:



Split system indoor and outdoor units

Ducted air conditioning systems

Evaporator coils and condenser coils

Blocked drains and drain pumps

Refrigerant leaks and pressure-related concerns

Compressor faults

Outdoor PCB faults

Indoor PCB faults

Fan motor faults

Thermistors and sensors

Capacitors

Zone motors and dampers

Airflow issues

Dirty filters and poor maintenance

Mould and microbial contamination inside AC systems

Condensation leaks

System age and replacement recommendations

Parts availability and repair feasibility

Electrical isolation and safety considerations

Preventative maintenance recommendations

Repair versus replacement recommendations



You do not need to physically diagnose systems yourself, but you must understand enough HVAC terminology and service logic to support the field team properly.



Who This Role Is Not For



Please do not apply if you are only a general virtual assistant with no HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services experience.



Please do not apply if you cannot understand technical job notes.



Please do not apply if you are uncomfortable calling suppliers or following up technicians.



Please do not apply if you rely only on AI to write technical reports without understanding the HVAC issue.



Please do not apply if you need to be told every small step throughout the day.



We need someone who is technically capable, organised, reliable, detail-focused and able to think.



Working Style



Remote work from home.



You will be working with an Australian company, so strong communication and reliability are essential.



Australian business hours are required.



You must be comfortable making phone calls to suppliers when required.



You must be comfortable asking technicians clear questions when information is missing.



You must be able to follow company templates, reporting standards and tone of voice.



You must be able to prepare reports and quotes that sound professional, trustworthy and technically sound.



You must care about accuracy. These reports and quotes are sent to real customers, property managers, landlords and commercial clients.



Example Tasks



Prepare a diagnosis report from technician notes and photos.



Prepare a repair quote after a technician identifies a suspected faulty fan motor, PCB, sensor, drain issue or compressor-related concern.



Call a supplier to check price and availability for a replacement PCB or fan motor.



Arrange delivery or pick-up of a new air conditioning system for an installation job.



Follow up a technician because job photos or fault notes are incomplete.



Check whether a technician completed all scheduled works for the day.



Review vehicle tracking and job times to help maintain technician time logs.



Prepare a recommendation explaining why an older system may not be economical to repair.



Prepare a ducted system maintenance proposal for a property manager.



Prepare a split AC hygiene report showing contamination, cleaning work completed and future maintenance recommendations.



Prepare a commercial client proposal for scheduled maintenance or hygiene works.



Update the office team about supplier delays, parts availability or technician job progress.



Personal Qualities We Want



Technically minded

Excellent written and spoken English

Confident calling suppliers

Organised and structured

Honest and reliable

Fast learner

Strong attention to detail

Self-motivated

Calm under pressure

Able to work with minimal supervision

Good at following up people politely but firmly

Proud of producing high-quality work

Comfortable working in a growing business where systems continue to improve



Training



We will provide training on our company templates, service categories, reporting style, quote structure, supplier processes, technician workflows and internal systems.



However, we are specifically looking for someone who already has real HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services knowledge. We can train you on our systems, but we cannot train a complete beginner from scratch for this role.



Compensation



Competitive monthly salary based on experience, HVAC knowledge, English quality, supplier coordination ability and overall operations experience.



There is long-term growth potential for the right person as our company expands into more HVAC services, commercial maintenance, property management work, mould remediation, restoration and technical proposal work.



How to Apply



Please send your application with the following:



Your HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration or mechanical services experience.

Your experience preparing reports, quotes, proposals or technical documentation.

Your experience calling suppliers, sourcing parts, arranging deliveries or coordinating technicians.

The types of AC systems you understand best.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your internet speed and available working hours.

Your experience with job management systems, CRMs, Google Workspace or spreadsheets.

A short explanation of why you would be suitable for this role.



Applications that do not mention HVAC, air conditioning, refrigeration, supplier coordination or technical operations experience will not be prioritised.

title: Experienced SEO Specialist - ₱68,000/month ($1,100 USD) - Remote Full-Time
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



Many applicants have missed the How to Apply instructions and submitted applications without the required SEO results or without
ing us. Please read the requirements below before you apply.



Our preferred way to apply is to
 Mark directly at 
 with your resume and BOTH of the following:



1. Google Search Console screenshots for the websites you personally optimized, showing the organic clicks and impressions graph and the date range so we can assess your results.



2. For EACH website you submit, a list of at least 15–20 keywords you personally helped rank within the top 3 organic positions on Google. Identify the website and the approximate ranking period for each list.



We are a private equity-backed organization managing 30+ businesses across healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. Our Philippine-based team includes more than 25 skilled professionals across SEO, content, web development, and digital marketing. We are now looking for an experienced SEO Specialist who can take full ownership of a portfolio of websites and drive measurable growth in organic rankings, traffic, leads, and conversions. Your primary objective will be to help established and newly launched websites rank within the top 3 positions in Google.

This is not a basic SEO role. We need someone who can develop the strategy, determine what needs to be done, execute at a high level, and take responsibility for the results.



MAIN REQUIREMENTS



1. Strong Content Marketing Skills



We believe that high-quality content accounts for a significant portion of SEO success. The right candidate must understand how to plan and create content that satisfies search intent, demonstrates genuine expertise, and performs well in both Google Search and AI-powered search engines. You do not need to be a full-time writer, and you will have access to our in-house content team. 



We are not looking for someone who simply assigns keywords to writers. You must be capable of directing the complete content strategy and ensuring that every page has a clear purpose and a realistic opportunity to rank.



2. Proven Top 3 Position in Google



You must provide verifiable evidence that you have personally helped websites rank within the top 3 organic Google positions for at least 15–20 meaningful and competitive keywords. We regularly receive applications from candidates who can discuss SEO concepts but cannot demonstrate significant ranking results. For this role, actual results are essential.



Your evidence should include:

• Google Search Console screenshots showing improvements in clicks and impressions

• A list of websites you directly optimized

• At least 15–20 keywords that reached Google’s top three organic positions

• The approximate ranking period or timeline

• Your specific responsibilities and the actions you personally implemented

• Supporting screenshots or third-party ranking reports, when available



Important Disclaimer Regarding Results:



The results you submit must be primarily attributable to your own strategy and execution. Please do not present the overall success of a large SEO team if you were only a minor contributor or handled a limited portion of the work.



3. Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Ability



SEO presents different challenges, and the same strategy will not work in every situation. We need someone who can diagnose problems, identify likely causes, prioritize the right actions, and adjust the strategy based on evidence.

We are not looking for someone who relies on generic SEO checklists. You must be able to investigate each situation using data, form a clear diagnosis, recommend a practical solution, and measure whether your strategy is working.

We do not want to micromanage the person in this role. You will be given clear business objectives, target websites, and performance expectations. We are looking for a mature, proactive professional who can work with minimal supervision, take responsibility for decisions, communicate problems early, and remain accountable for results.

If progress slows down, you should investigate why and recommend the next course of action - not wait for someone to tell you what to do.



WHY WORK WITH US?



1. Above-Average Compensation



Earn approximately ₱68,000 per month ($1,100 USD), with opportunities for compensation increases as you deliver measurable results and create greater value for the business.



2. Career Growth



High performers can qualify for faster promotions, salary increases, bonuses, and performance-based incentives. We reward people who consistently create meaningful business impact.



3. Exposure to 27 Businesses



Work across companies in healthcare, construction, real estate, consulting, and other industries. This provides a breadth of SEO and business experience that few professionals have the opportunity to develop.



4. Experienced Digital Leadership



Work alongside leaders with extensive experience in SEO, paid advertising, conversion rate optimization, digital marketing, and business growth.



5. Strong Internal Support



You will have access to in-house writers, developers, and other digital specialists. Although you will own the SEO strategy, you will not be expected to execute every supporting task alone.



6. Fully Remote



Work from anywhere in the Philippines, provided you have a reliable internet connection and can collaborate effectively with our international team.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to 
 



Please include all of the following:



1. Your updated resume
