title: Civil & Earthworks Estimator
description:
About Rockleigh Services



Rockleigh Services is an Australian-owned earthmoving and civil construction contractor based in South Australia. We work with private clients, builders, developers and commercial businesses on projects ranging from small earthworks through to subdivisions and civil infrastructure.



Our work includes land subdivisions; bulk earthworks and site preparation; roads, access roads and driveways; stormwater drainage, pits, culverts and headwalls; underground water and electrical service trenches; retaining walls and gabion walls; civil concrete; building and shed pads; demolition; and general earthmoving. Our fleet includes excavators, bulldozers, graders, skid steers, rollers and specialised equipment.



About the position



We are seeking an experienced Estimator to provide reliable and detail-oriented pricing, quotes and proposals to support the ongoing growth and success of Rockleigh Services. The role involves interpreting drawings, completing accurate take-offs and bills of quantities (BOQs), preparing cost breakdowns, coordinating with suppliers and our internal team to prepare and submit professional quotations and tenders.

This is a technical estimating position, not simply data entry. The successful applicant must understand how civil and earthmoving works are undertaken, recognise gaps in documentation, and take responsibility for the accuracy of their work. We encourage you to ask questions rather than guess.



Duties & responsibilities

Estimating and quantity take-offs

• Review civil engineering drawings, specifications, construction plans and tender documents.

• Prepare detailed quantity take-offs and BOQs for earthworks, drainage, underground services, roadworks and associated civil works.

• Calculate excavation, cut and fill, trenching, spoil disposal, bedding, backfill, aggregate, concrete, pipe and pit quantities.

• Identify machinery, labour, materials, haulage and subcontractor requirements, including construction sequencing and anticipated productivity.

• Apply company-approved rates and assumptions to build detailed cost estimates for management review.

Tendering and quotations

• Break projects into logical work activities and produce clear, itemised quotation breakdowns.

• Identify inclusions, exclusions, allowances, assumptions, variations and potential project risks.

• Identify missing or conflicting information and prepare requests for information (RFIs).

• Update estimates as drawings and scopes change; assist with variation pricing and tender submissions.

• Prepare materials lists and pricing enquiries for Australian suppliers and subcontractors.

• Compare supplier and subcontractor quotations, specifications and scope differences.

• Maintain organised estimating files, cost libraries, calculations and tender records.

• Track outstanding pricing, deadlines and documentation and give clear progress updates to management.



Qualifications & Experience

Required

• Demonstrated estimating experience in civil construction, earthworks or infrastructure.

• Ability to interpret civil engineering drawings and produce accurate, auditable take-offs and BOQs.

• Understanding of excavation, drainage, underground services, construction materials and earthmoving methods.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills and sound numerical accuracy.

• Good written and spoken English, reliable communication and ability to work independently.

Preferred

• Experience estimating Australian civil construction projects and familiarity with Australian terminology and metric units.

• Understanding of machinery productivity, earthmoving costs, hire rates and construction programs.

• Previous experience supporting an Australian contractor remotely.

• Engineering degree or equivalent background



Working arrangements

• Remote position based in the Philippines, working with our South Australian team.

• Full-time, long-term position as an independent contractor.

• Fixed hours: Monday to Friday 9:30am-5:30pm (ACST/ACDT) – 7:00am to 3:00pm / 7:30am to 3:30pm Philippines Time depending on daylight savings

• Must have a professional set up: reliable, fast computer and internet, plus a good quality webcam an microphone for video calls and screen sharing. 



How to apply

We read every application – please follow these steps:

• Start your message with the word ‘Rockleigh’ so we know you read this ad to the end.

• A short explanation of the civil works you have personally estimated, including project types.

• In three to four sentences tell us about a recent project you priced / quoted. Include details about your process, any tools or software you used, and what you produced. 

• Include a copy of your resume / CV

title: Strategic Web Designer, Figma + Website Strategy
description:
Full-Time Remote Role, Philippines-Based

----------------------------------------------------------

We are looking for a full-time Strategic Website Designer based in the Philippines.



This role is ideal for someone strong in Figma, understands website design, and can think strategically about clients, their customers, brand direction, industry patterns, and what makes a website work.



This is not just a production design role. We are looking for someone who can understand the brief, think through the customer journey, research competitors, recommend website direction, and then support that direction in Figma.



Role Overview

-------------------

You will help turn client goals, customer needs, brand direction, website references, and competitor research into a clear internal website strategy and design direction.



You do not need to lead client calls, but you must be able to sit in meetings, understand what clients are saying, extract the important points, and translate that into useful internal notes, design direction, and Figma updates.



You will work closely with our internal team across website strategy, design, and delivery





Key Responsibilities

---------------------------

- Review client briefs, meeting notes, recordings, brand assets, and website references

- Understand what the client wants, what their customers need, and what the website needs to achieve

- Analyse websites the client likes and dislikes

- Research competitor websites and industry patterns

- Identify trust signals, conversion sections, content structure, and visual styles that work in each industry

- Recommend website direction based on customer needs and business goals

- Create look-and-feel concepts in Figma

- Create new website sections in Figma

- Improve layout, spacing, hierarchy, flow, and visual polish

- Update existing Figma designs based on internal direction

- Write clear internal notes explaining design decisions and strategic recommendations

- Keep ClickUp tasks updated with progress, blockers, and time entries

- Communicate clearly with the team via Slack and Google Docs

- Use ChatGPT to support research, summaries, and strategic thinking where useful



What We Are Looking For

-----------------------------------

You should be a mid-to-senior-level website designer with strong strategic thinking.



You should be able to take messy input and turn it into clear website direction.



We are looking for someone who can think before designing.



A strong candidate can say:

“Based on the customer’s needs, the homepage should build trust early, show proof, and make the offer clear, reduce friction, and use a more premium visual direction because the market is crowded.”



A weak candidate only says:

“I can make modern websites in Figma.”



We are looking for the first type.





Required Skills

---------------------

- Strong Figma skills

- Website design experience

- Ability to create new website sections, not just edit existing designs

- Good understanding of layout, spacing, hierarchy, and visual polish

- Ability to create early look-and-feel concepts

- Ability to understand client brands

- Ability to analyse competitor websites

- Ability to understand customer needs and website goals

- Clear written English for internal notes and design rationale

- Good communication in Slack and Google Docs

- Comfortable using ClickUp for task updates and time tracking

- Comfortable using ChatGPT as a thinking and research support tool



English Requirement

-----------------------------

You do not need to be a copywriter or client presenter.



However, you must be able to write clear internal notes, summarise client requirements, explain design decisions, and provide simple website section direction.



Example of the level we need:

“The client wants the site to feel modern, premium, and trustworthy. Their customers are likely comparing providers, so the homepage should quickly communicate credibility, outcomes, and service clarity. The reference websites suggest they prefer clean layouts, strong imagery, and simple navigation.”



Tools You Must Be Comfortable With

----------------------------------------------------

- Figma

- ClickUp

- Slack

- Google Docs

- ChatGPT



Work Hours

-----------------

This is a full-time role.



You must be available to work:

- 9:00 am to 5:30 pm Australian Eastern Standard Time



For candidates in the Philippines, this is usually around:

- 7:00 am to 3:30 pm Philippines time



Please only apply if you can work these hours long-term.



Role Structure

-------------------

- Full-time remote contractor role

- Philippines-based candidates only

- 3-month probation period

- If successful after probation, the role continues on the same agreed monthly salary

- 1 week's notice during probation

- 2 weeks' notice after probation

- Unpaid leave only

- Contractor must provide their own laptop, stable internet, and suitable work setup

- This is a fully exclusive role. You must not work with other clients while engaged in this role

- Daily time tracking is required in ClickUp

- No screenshots or activity monitoring required

- Confidentiality and IP ownership agreement required



Access and Confidentiality

------------------------------------

You will have access to internal documentation, project files, client information, Figma files, brand assets, and other materials required to do the role well.



All work created during the role, including strategy notes, design concepts, Figma files, website layouts, written documentation, research outputs, and related assets, will be owned by the company.



You may not share client work publicly, use it in a portfolio, or reuse it elsewhere without written approval.





Who This Role Is Not For

---------------------------------

Please do not apply if:

- You only want to follow the exact design instructions

- You are not comfortable thinking strategically

- You cannot explain your design decisions

- You do not like researching competitors or industries

- You only want production design tasks

- You cannot work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

- You are currently working with other clients and want to keep doing so

- You are not comfortable with ClickUp time tracking





How To Apply

--------------------

Submit your application to 



Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your Figma portfolio or links to website design work

3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP

4. Confirmation that you can work 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AEST

5. Confirmation that you are available for a full-time exclusive role

“Tell us about a website you designed or improved. What was the client trying to achieve, and who was the

customer, and why did you choose that design direction?”



Applications that only say “I am interested” without answering the above will not be considered

TL;DR



Role: Sales Caller (Dialer) Pay: $1,200 USD guaranteed base. Plus bonuses you can earn every single day for hitting your targets. Schedule: You must work from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM GMT+8 every day, but weekends we have lesser traffic. Client Revenue: The business makes $270,000 USD per month. Job: You call 100s of people a day. You are fast. You are diligent. Tracking: We do not screenshot your computer. We only care about your results. Requirement: You must send a voice note or video to apply.



JOB TITLE: HIGH-VOLUME SALES CALLER



WHAT IS THIS JOB? (READ THIS FIRST)



We are an education company. We sell a program that teaches people how to start online businesses. The program costs $5,000.



Our company makes $270,000 USD every month. We have too many people asking for help and not enough people to call them.



We need a "Dialer." Your job is to call these people on the phone. You are the engine. You call them fast. You make sure they are real. You help them buy our small $7 course if they cannot afford the big one.



WHO YOU ARE



• Experience: You do not need experience in this specific industry. You just need a proven history of being diligent (hard-working). • Fast & Punctual: You are always on time. You move fast. • Open To Learn: You listen to feedback and get better every day. • Tech: You have fast internet and a quiet room.



THE WORK CULTURE



We do not treat you like a baby.



We do not track your hours. We do not record your screen.



All we care about is: How fast did you call? And what happened on the call?



Every day you work is paid. If you need to take a leave, that is paid too. Everything is paid.



But it runs both ways. If you take excessive leaves for no real reason and become unreliable, we cannot keep working with you. We treat you like an adult. Act like one.



THE SCHEDULE



6:00 AM to 3:00 PM GMT+8.

WHAT YOU WILL DO (THE DAILY WORK)

Most calls are short. • Sell The Small Stuff: If someone cannot afford $5,000, you sell them our $7 course. You do not let them leave with nothing. • Check In: You call students on Day 3 and Day 6 of their course to see if they are doing the work.



THE RULES (NO EXCUSES)



• Speed Rule: You call new leads within 5 minutes. We track this automatically. • Note Rule: You write a note in the computer (CRM) for every call. If you do not write it, you do not get paid.



THE MONEY



Base Pay: $1,200 USD per month. This is guaranteed if you do the work.



Bonuses: We have many bonuses for hitting targets, and you can earn them every single day. The harder you work, the more you make.



Our current dialer earned $2,200 USD last month. She started at $1,200 base — the bonuses stacked because she put in the work.



HOW TO APPLY (MANDATORY)



Do not send a CV. We will ignore it.



Apply here:

Explain to me WHY you have the ability and time to dial a lead within 5 minutes.

What is the exact model number of your phone? (Just the model number is fine.)

Schedule: 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM GMT+8. 7 days a week. This is an all-day job. Client: One of the biggest drop shipping offers in all of Asia and all of Singapore. The business makes $270,000 USD per month. Job: You reply to inbound leads on Instagram through GoHighLevel. You qualify them. You book calls for the closer. Tracking: None. We only care about your results. Requirement: You must send a Loom video to apply.



Job Title: DM Setter

What Is This Job? (Read This First)

We are a sales management company that runs the entire sales operation for education businesses. Our clients sell high-ticket programs ($5,000+) that teach people how to start online businesses.



The client you will work for is one of the biggest drop shipping offers in all of Asia and all of Singapore. They make $270,000 USD every month and are scaling fast.



This is an inbound business. We are not cold-DMing strangers. Every day, hundreds of people come to our client's Instagram already interested. They ask for help. They want to hear about the offer. They show buying signals before you say a word. There are too many of them and not enough setters to qualify them.



Your job is to talk to those leads through GoHighLevel (our CRM). You qualify them through our framework. You book real calls for our closer. You are the first person in the pipeline. Every booking you put on the calendar must be real.



This is not a copy-paste bot role. This is real written conversation. If you cannot write clean English, do not apply.



Who You Are

We are picky. We only hire two kinds of people. If you are not both, do not apply.



You speak and write great English. Native-level or close. Full sentences. Correct grammar. Correct spelling. No "k," "yup," "lol," no slang, no shortcuts. When a stranger reads your message, they assume you are educated and from a Western country. If your English is "okay" or "decent," this role is not for you. Leads will not buy from someone who writes like a chatbot.

You are a sharp thinker. You read what the lead actually said. You catch what they did not say. You connect dots fast — what they want, what they are afraid of, what is stopping them from buying. You can hold a real conversation that goes off-script and bring it back on track. Slow, literal, script-bound thinkers do not survive here.

Coachable: You take feedback, implement it the same day, and you do not make the same mistake twice. Everyone here is a player.

No Heavy Commitments: The best candidates here have no family, no kids, no second job, no commitments that take their time. This role is 12 hours a day, 7 days a week. In exchange you make life-changing money.

Experience: You do not need DM setting experience. We will teach you the framework. We cannot teach you English fluency or sharp thinking — you bring those.

Tech: You have fast internet, a quiet room, a smartphone, and a laptop.

The Work Culture

We work on common sense.



If you are sick, you do not work. We do not expect you to push through illness. But if you are sick three days every single week, we will fire you. That is an inefficient employee.



We do not babysit. Everyone here is taught the framework, given the tools, and trusted to perform. We do not expect you to make the same mistake twice. Everyone here is a player.



We do not track your hours. We do not record your screen. We do not care how many tabs you have open or if you take a break. We are not watching.



All we care about is: Did you reply fast? Did you book a qualified call? Did the lead show up?



You will represent a Dynamis client. That client must be happy with their sales team. When you DM a lead, you are the brand.



You are an adult. We treat you like one. Show us results and you will never have a problem here.



The Schedule

Time: 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM GMT+8. 7 days a week.



This is an all-day job. There is always a lead to talk to. You will be sending or replying to messages every 10 to 15 minutes throughout the shift. There is no quiet hour where you can step away.



This is non-negotiable.



What You Will Do (The Daily Work)

Reply Fast: When a lead messages, you respond in under 10 minutes during shift. Faster is better. Most of your replies should land within 3 to 4 minutes.

Qualify Every Lead: Before you share the booking link, you confirm all five: (1) they have the problem we solve, (2) they are motivated to fix it, (3) they are willing to act NOW, (4) they have the money, (5) they are the decision maker. No shortcuts.

Book Real Calls: You only mark a call "Booked" when the lead confirms the time AND sends you a screenshot of their calendar. No screenshot, no booking.

Update GoHighLevel: Every lead, every day. HOT, WARM, COLD, or UNQUALIFIED. Zero leads left unmarked at end of day.

Follow Up: When a lead goes quiet — after an objection, after a booking, after any key step — you follow up 48 hours later. You do not let leads rot.

The KPIs (Non-Negotiable)

Under 10-minute reply on warm leads during shift.

20 qualified calls booked per week.

80%+ show rate on booked calls.

GoHighLevel updated daily. Zero unmarked leads at end of day.

By applying, you acknowledge that these KPIs are non-negotiable and absolutely mandatory.



The Money

title: FOUNDING INTEGRATOR / GENERAL MANAGER
description:
Compensation: $1,100–$1,350/month (Base Pay) + additional performance-based profit sharing, with a potential transition to higher, fixed compensation and more bonuses



Schedule: Approximately 40 hours/week (option to start part-time).





ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We're building a U.S.-based strategic AI systems consulting business that helps small and midsize businesses simplify operations, standardize processes, and implement effective systems and automation.



We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Integrator / General Manager to help build and operate the company alongside its founder.



This is not a traditional operations management position where you inherit an established team, documented processes, and a fully functioning organization.



You'll help build those things.



The founder is a Visionary who brings strategy, innovation, opportunities, and big-picture thinking. We need a complementary Integrator who brings structure, focus, and consistent execution.



Your mission is to help turn an ambitious vision into a focused, repeatable, profitable business that can eventually operate without the founder's daily involvement.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Business Operations & Execution



- Build and manage the company's day-to-day operations.

- Translate strategic goals into clear priorities, projects, deadlines, and measurable results.

- Develop, document, and implement repeatable business processes.

- Establish effective systems for managing projects, responsibilities, and accountability.

- Identify operational bottlenecks and eliminate inefficiencies.

- Create and manage weekly company Scorecards, quarterly Rocks, and Level 10 Meetings.

- Use structured problem-solving methods to resolve issues.

- Maintain consistent execution while protecting the team from unnecessary changes in direction.

- Gradually eliminate the founder's involvement in routine operational decisions.



2. Financial Management & Profitability



- Help develop a commercially viable, scalable business model.

- Build financial models, forecasts, and operating budgets.

- Understand and improve revenue, profit margins, cash flow, and unit economics.

- Identify opportunities to increase revenue and reduce unnecessary costs.

- Evaluate business ideas based on profitability, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

- Establish measurable financial and operational KPIs.

- Make decisions using data rather than assumptions.



3. Leadership & Team Building



- Identify which roles and capabilities the business needs.

- Build the organizational structure and Accountability Chart.

- Recruit, hire, onboard, and manage team members as the business grows.

- Delegate responsibilities and establish clear ownership.

- Develop department leaders and hold them accountable for results.

- Resolve personnel and cross-department issues.

- Build a disciplined, capable, and cohesive team.



4. Strategic Partnership With the Founder



- Work directly with the founder to establish company priorities, objectives, and strategic direction.

- Help determine which opportunities deserve attention and which should be postponed or rejected.

- Translate broad ideas into practical plans and actionable requirements.

- Provide objective feedback, identify risks, and challenge assumptions.

- Take ownership of HOW the business operates while the founder focuses primarily on vision, innovation, and strategic relationships.

- Act as a trusted operational counterpart, not merely an assistant or task coordinator.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essential Qualifications:



- Proven experience managing business operations, preferably in an agency, consulting firm, technology company, or professional services business.

- Demonstrated ability to build processes, systems, or teams from an early stage.

- Strong financial and commercial understanding.

- Experience managing projects, priorities, and operational accountability.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong independent decision-making and problem-solving abilities.

- Comfortable working directly with a founder in an evolving business.

- Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Personal Characteristics:



- Highly organized, disciplined, and dependable.

- Naturally focused on execution and measurable outcomes.

- Comfortable creating order from ambiguity.

- Willing to challenge ideas respectfully and constructively.

- Capable of making difficult decisions.

- Calm under pressure and realistic about available resources.

- Proactive, resourceful, and accountable.

- More interested in building a successful company than receiving personal recognition.



Preferred Experience:



- Previously served as an Operations Manager, General Manager, COO, Integrator, or similar operational leader.

- Built or scaled a small business.

- Experience implementing EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) or comparable business management frameworks.

- Familiarity with AI tools, CRM systems, workflow automation, and business process improvement.

- Demonstrated improvements in revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, or team performance.





WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



This is an early-stage leadership opportunity.



You'll work directly with the founder and help shape the business from the ground up.



You'll have meaningful input into strategy, organizational design, systems, hiring, and daily operations.



We're not looking for someone who needs an established business to manage. We're looking for someone who knows how to help build one.



We're also not looking for a virtual assistant or project coordinator who simply follows the founder's latest instructions.



We need someone who can think independently, challenge ideas, establish priorities, make decisions, and take ownership of results.





COMPENSATION & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



The position will begin part-time, with base compensation and an agreed performance-based profit-sharing arrangement.



Our intention is to reward meaningful contributions to the company's growth and profitability.



As the business develops, the goal is to transition the position toward stable fixed compensation with performance bonuses and potentially full-time leadership responsibilities.



Compensation, profit-sharing calculations, performance expectations, and review periods will be agreed upon in writing before work begins.



This position does not automatically include company equity.





HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Relevant Experience:

Have you ever helped build or scale a business? What was your role, and what measurable results did you achieve?



2. Operational Systems:

Describe a business process or operating system you personally built or improved.



3. Financial Performance:

Give a specific example of how you increased revenue, improved profitability, or reduced operating costs.



4. Founder Partnership:

How would you handle a founder who generates many new ideas and frequently wants to change priorities?



5. First 90 Days:

Imagine joining a small AI consulting business with limited revenue, no current employees, and few established processes. What would your first 90 days look like?



6. Availability:

How many hours per week can you commit initially, and what are your compensation expectations?



Please provide specific examples and measurable results wherever possible.



We're looking for someone who has demonstrated the ability to build, lead, prioritize, execute, and improve business performance - not simply someone with an impressive job title.

title: ## Recruiting & Marketing Coordinator – U.S. Healthcare Staffing
description:
## Recruiting & Marketing Coordinator – U.S. Healthcare Staffing  

**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Pacific Time**



Company is a U.S.-based healthcare staffing company specializing in infusion nursing services throughout Southern California. We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and results-driven **Recruiting & Marketing Coordinator** to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This is **not a general virtual assistant position**. We are looking for someone who enjoys recruiting, communicating with people, making outbound calls, following up consistently, and working toward measurable results.



The primary responsibility of this position will be **recruiting Registered Nurses**. The secondary responsibility will be assisting with marketing and business-development activities.



### PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY – NURSE RECRUITING



You will be responsible for helping company continuously build its network of qualified nurses throughout Southern California.



Responsibilities include:



- Source Registered Nurses using Indeed, LinkedIn, nursing job boards, social media, databases, referrals, and other recruiting channels.

- Contact prospective nurses by telephone, text,
, and other approved communication methods.

- Conduct initial candidate screening interviews.

- Explain company job opportunities clearly and professionally to prospective nurses.

- Determine candidates' experience, geographic coverage, availability, and clinical qualifications.

- Recruit nurses with infusion-related experience.

- Follow up consistently with candidates who have expressed interest.

- Re-engage nurses who previously applied or stopped responding.

- Schedule qualified candidates for interviews.

- Assist candidates through the onboarding process.

- Follow up on missing credentials and documentation.

- Maintain an accurate recruiting database and candidate pipeline.

- Track nurse availability by city, ZIP code, county, and service area.

- Identify geographic areas where additional nurses are needed and recruit specifically for those areas.

- Maintain detailed notes regarding every candidate interaction.

- Prepare weekly recruiting reports showing activity, conversion rates, qualified candidates, onboarding progress, and activated nurses.



**Success in this position will be measured by qualified nurses recruited and activated — not simply by the number of calls made or resumes collected.**



### SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITY – MARKETING & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SUPPORT



You will also assist company with marketing and business-development activities, including:



- Research home infusion pharmacies, specialty pharmacies, ambulatory infusion centers, and other potential healthcare clients.

- Identify appropriate decision-makers and contact information.

- Build and maintain prospect lists.

- Assist with LinkedIn prospecting and company-page activities.

- Prepare approved marketing
s and outreach communications.

- Assist with
 campaigns.

- Follow up with prospective clients when assigned.

- Maintain sales and marketing databases or CRM records.

- Track outreach activities and responses.

- Conduct competitor and market research.

- Assist with preparing marketing materials and presentations.

- Support social-media and digital-marketing initiatives.

- Prepare weekly marketing activity reports.



### REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



**Excellent English is mandatory.**



Applicants must have:



- Excellent spoken English.

- Excellent written English, grammar, and professional communication skills.

- Strong telephone communication skills.

- Confidence making outbound calls to candidates.

- Strong follow-up skills and persistence.

- Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to maintain accurate records and follow established processes.

- Professional demeanor when speaking with U.S.-based nurses and healthcare professionals.

- Ability to learn healthcare terminology and understand different nursing specialties.

- Experience using Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar business applications.

- Comfortable learning new software, databases, CRM systems, and AI-assisted tools.



### PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Candidates with experience in any of the following are strongly preferred:



- US Healthcare recruiting

- US Nurse recruiting

- U.S. healthcare staffing

- U.S. recruitment or talent acquisition

- High-volume recruiting

- Candidate sourcing

- LinkedIn recruiting

- Indeed recruiting

- Outbound telephone recruiting

- Staffing-agency recruiting

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Healthcare marketing



Experience recruiting nurses or other U.S. healthcare professionals is a major advantage.



### WORK SCHEDULE



This position supports a California-based company and requires working **U.S. Pacific Time business hours**.



Expected schedule:



**Monday–Friday  

Approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Pacific Time**



Candidates must be comfortable working the corresponding overnight schedule in the Philippines.



Reliability and punctuality are extremely important.



### BYOD – BRING YOUR OWN DEVICE



**BYOD is mandatory.**



You must provide and maintain your own:



- Reliable computer/laptop suitable for full-time professional work.

- Headset with clear microphone and good audio quality.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Backup internet connection or dependable contingency plan for internet outages.

- Quiet and professional workspace suitable for telephone calls and video meetings.



Applicants should have a computer capable of comfortably running multiple browser tabs, Microsoft Office/web applications, video conferencing, recruiting platforms, and other business software simultaneously.



### WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:

- Results-oriented.

- Dependable.

- Resourceful.

- Self-motivated.

- Highly organized.

If you dislike telephone calls or prefer primarily administrative/data-entry work, this position is probably not a good fit.



### PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



The Recruiting & Marketing Coordinator will be expected to maintain measurable weekly performance in areas such as:

- Candidates contacted

- Candidate response rate

- Candidates screened

- Qualified nurses identified

- Nurses beginning onboarding

title: Editorial / Publication Designer
description:
Type: Freelance / Project-Based (Adobe InDesign + Print)

Project Period: November 2026–March 2027

Estimated Time: Approximately 80–100 hours total, with workload varying throughout the project

Rate: $10–12 USD/hour, depending on experience and portfolio

Location: Remote / Philippines

Potential: Recurring publication work for the right designer





ABOUT THE PROJECT



Good Done Daily is a small graphic design practice based in Detroit, Michigan (USA). We work primarily with nonprofit, civic, philanthropic, and community-based organizations.



I am looking for an experienced editorial and publication designer to collaborate with me on the redesign of a semiannual print magazine for a U.S.-based nonprofit organization.



The publication is approximately 16 pages, full color, professionally printed, and mailed to a large audience.



The project includes two connected parts:



1. Develop a stronger, reusable editorial design system.

2. Apply that system to the first redesigned issue and prepare it for professional printing.



This is not primarily a social media or general marketing-design role. I am specifically looking for someone with substantial experience designing magazines, publications, books, annual reports, or other multi-page print work.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You should have:



• 8+ years of professional graphic design experience

• Strong experience with editorial, magazine, publication, or long-form print design

• Advanced to expert knowledge of Adobe InDesign

• Strong Adobe Photoshop skills for retouching, color correction, masking, compositing, and image preparation

• Strong typography, composition, hierarchy, pacing, and layout skills

• A systems-oriented approach to design

• Professional experience preparing files for commercial print production

• A portfolio showing substantial multi-page editorial work



Working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator is also expected.





INDESIGN + PRINT PRODUCTION



You should be highly comfortable with:



• Parent/master pages

• Paragraph, character, and object styles

• Baseline grids and layout grids

• Multi-column text flow and long-form documents

• Linked assets and organized file structures

• Templates and reusable publication systems

• CMYK and color-management principles

• Bleeds, trim, margins, image resolution, and print specifications

• Preflight and error checking

• Print-ready PDF export and file packaging



Professional print-production knowledge is required. You should understand how to prepare technically correct files for a commercial printer, not only how to create attractive layouts.





WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



Editorial design system



• Develop one primary visual direction

• Establish grids, page structures, typography, hierarchy, and recurring elements

• Design representative covers, features, articles, contents pages, short-form sections, and back-of-book layouts

• Develop treatments for photography, captions, pull quotes, credits, and supporting graphics

• Build a flexible InDesign system that can be reused across future issues



First redesigned issue



• Apply the approved system to an approximately 16-page magazine

• Lay out articles and recurring sections

• Retouch, crop, and prepare supplied photography

• Adapt layouts to different story lengths and image availability

• Refine pages through review and feedback

• Preflight, package, and prepare final files for commercial printing



AI-generated photography or illustration will not be used as final publication artwork.





HOW WE WILL WORK TOGETHER



I will provide overall creative direction, client communication, design critique, and project oversight.



I am looking for someone who can take that direction and work independently at a high level—someone who can help develop the system and then execute it carefully in layout and production.



You should:



• Think in systems rather than designing every page from scratch

• Have excellent attention to typography and production details

• Keep InDesign files and linked assets organized

• Communicate clearly and ask questions when needed

• Respond well to direct design feedback

• Meet agreed deadlines

• Identify design or production problems before they become larger issues



The project will include both lighter planning periods and more concentrated design and production phases. You should be comfortable working efficiently during active periods, managing deadlines, and maintaining strong attention to detail under normal production pressure.



Occasional scheduled overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be needed for design reviews and will be arranged in advance. I’m happy to be reasonably flexible around timing and, when possible, schedule meetings at hours that work comfortably for both of us rather than always requiring late-evening availability in the Philippines.



The estimated 80–100 hours will be distributed across the full project period. Workload will vary by phase, with lighter weeks and more concentrated design and production periods. Applicants should generally have capacity for up to 15 hours per week when the project is most active.



For the right designer, there may be opportunities to continue working on future spring and fall issues and other Good Done Daily publication projects.





HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A link to your portfolio.

2. Two or three examples of magazine, publication, book, annual report, or other multi-page print work that you personally designed.

3. A short description of your role on those projects.

4. Your years of professional design experience.

5. A brief description of your Adobe InDesign and commercial print-production experience.

6. Your current hourly rate.

7. Your availability from November 2026 through March 2027.



Please do not submit only social media graphics, logos, branding mockups, or advertising work. I need to see actual multi-page editorial design.



Individual applicants only, please. I am looking to work directly with the designer who will be completing the work, not an agency or subcontracted team.



Begin your application with the words “SYSTEMS FIRST” so I know you have read the full posting.



There is no unpaid design test required for the initial application. Selected finalists may be invited to a short conversation and, if needed, a small paid design exercise.

income tax returns accurately and within required deadlines.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Facebook and Instagram Ads (CapCut, Remote, Long-Term, $5/hr CAD)
description:
PAY

$5 CAD per hour to start, raised to $6 CAD per hour after a 60-day review. At 25 to 35 hours a week that is roughly $540 to $760 CAD per month. Paid every two weeks by bank transfer to your Wise account or local bank.



HOURS

25 to 35 hours a week to start, with more hours as we add clients. Your schedule is flexible, but we need at least 3 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (Toronto) on working days for communication. For example, being online from 8 PM to 11 PM Manila time covers this.



ABOUT US

Acquirely is a Canadian Meta ads agency that helps local service businesses get more booked jobs from
 and Instagram. We work with real owners (painters, renovators, dog trainers and other local companies) who film short videos on their phones, and our job is to turn that footage into ads that make people stop scrolling and ask about the service. We are a small, fast-moving team, and the editor we hire will be one of the most important people in the business, because the video is what sells.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 9:16 vertical ads, usually 45 to 80 seconds long, from raw phone footage our clients upload to Google Drive.

- Edit about 20 to 35 videos a week across our clients, with each video turned around within 2 business days of the footage arriving, ideally sooner.

- Follow our written Editing Standards and Format Guides, which cover six ad formats (walk-and-talk transformations, selfie-style talking videos, job timelapses, customer testimonials, listed tips, and speed ramps). Consistent quality matters more to us than anything else.

- Build a strong first 3 seconds every time, with a text hook, a visual hook and an audio hook. Never open on a logo, filler, or a sentence that starts in the middle.

- Cut every "um", restart, repeat and pause, and match b-roll to exactly what the speaker is saying.

- Add clean captions with perfect spelling, balanced audio (voice first, then music, then sound effects), and only the effects that have a reason to be there.

- Build a reusable CapCut template for each format so a normal edit gets faster without losing quality.

- Upload finished videos to our review folder, apply feedback quickly, and flag missing or unusable footage in Slack the same day you find it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year editing short-form content for TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts or ads.

- Strong CapCut skills (this is our main tool). Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects experience is a bonus.

- A portfolio with at least 3 vertical videos you edited yourself, ideally ads or talking-head content.

- Good written and spoken English, because scripts, captions, feedback and meetings are all in English.

- A reliable computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power outages.

- You care about details, you hit deadlines, and you tell us early when something is going wrong. Communication and reliability are what we value most.



NICE TO HAVE

- You have edited ads for a business before and understand that an ad has to sell, not just look good.

- You can design simple static image ads in Canva.

- You have worked with a US or Canadian team before.



WHAT YOU GET

- Steady, long-term work with a growing agency, with more volume as we add clients.

- A raise to $6 CAD/hr after 60 days, with more growth for strong editors as the team expands.

- Clear written standards, example videos and direct feedback, so you always know what good looks like.

- One point of contact, fast answers, and no micromanaging once you have shown you can deliver.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the items below.

2. Shortlisted editors get a short paid test edit. We send raw footage and a script, you send back a finished ad.

3. A short video call with the founders.

4. Start, with a 60-day review and raise.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "ACQ" so we know you read the whole post. Applications without it will not be opened.



In your application, include:

1. Google Drive links to 3 vertical videos you edited, with one sentence on what you did in each.

2. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $5 CAD/hr starting rate, and how many hours a week you can work.

3. Your timezone, the hours you are usually online, and confirmation that you can cover at least 3 Eastern Time hours on working days.

4. Your answer to this question: "What should happen in the first 3 seconds of a
 ad, and why?"



Keep it short. We read every application that follows these steps.

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview

title: Part-Time Media Buyer - Meta & Google Ads (Ireland / International)
description:
Degalo Digital is hiring a reliable, experienced media buyer for ongoing remote work supporting local service businesses.



The portfolio contains 40+ client ad accounts. Most work is for Ireland, with potential campaigns in the UK, Australia and other countries. Our video editor supplies creative assets; you will turn clear briefs into correctly targeted, well-organised campaigns and keep accounts checked daily. Training on our workflow and client requirements will be provided, but you must already be confident using Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.



PAY AND HOURS

PHP25,000-PHP30,000 per month, depending on verified experience and the agreed workload. Expected workload is around 2-3 hours per day, approximately 14-21 hours per week. Tell us your requested monthly rate and the daily coverage you can reliably provide.



Work flexibly across the day, including weekends, with daily account checks. There is no fixed 9-to-5 shift. We may send a complete advert brief at different times; adverts should normally be uploaded/published as instructed within approximately 8-12 hours, with reasonable flexibility. Tell us how you will reliably provide this coverage in Ireland time (Europe/Dublin). Campaign volume varies; work will be prioritised within the agreed hours, and additional workload or availability must be agreed separately. We will review capacity and responsibilities after the initial onboarding period.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Publish supplied adverts and set up or update Meta and Google Ads campaigns from client briefs. For example: upload these new adverts to the specified client account, check all settings, publish as instructed and confirm completion.

- Check the correct client account, page, creative, copy, destination/lead form, conversion event, approved budget, schedule and location targeting before launch.

- Monitor account health, spend pacing, disapprovals, tracking problems, lead volume and cost per lead daily; flag problems clearly and promptly.

- Make agreed optimisations and recommendations using campaign data. Follow approval limits for changes to budgets and strategy.

- Maintain a simple account/task log, give brief daily updates, and complete two deeper performance reviews each week within the agreed hours.

- Work accurately across 40+ accounts and raise capacity conflicts early rather than missing launches or making rushed changes.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- At least 2 years of hands-on paid advertising experience, with strong practical experience in BOTH Meta/Facebook Ads and Google Ads.

- Demonstrable results from campaigns you personally managed. Local service lead generation and agency/multi-account experience are particularly relevant.

- Confidence with Meta campaign/ad set/ad structure and Google Search campaign structure, keywords, negative keywords, conversion tracking and location settings.

- Strong geographical research and targeting skills, particularly for Ireland. You must be able to locate places such as Galway correctly, distinguish city/county/service-area instructions, verify radii and exclusions, and check the correct country. Apply the same care to the UK, Australia and other markets.

- Clear written English, reliable internet, attention to detail and dependable daily communication.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject: DEGALO MEDIA BUYER - Your Name

Include:

1. Your relevant experience, stating how long you have personally worked with Meta Ads and Google Ads, and how many accounts you manage at once.

2. Two relevant campaign examples, ideally one Meta and one Google. Include the objective, country, date range, approximate spend, results/CPL or CPA, and your own role. Anonymise client details and hide private customer data.

3. Your available daily working/check-in windows in Ireland time, including weekends, current capacity and earliest start date.

4. Your requested monthly pay within PHP25,000-PHP30,000 and whether you propose closer to 2 or 3 hours per day.

5. A 3-5 minute Loom or similar screen recording demonstrating that you can prepare an advert correctly. Use an anonymised existing example or a draft/demo setup for a hypothetical roofing client serving Galway, Ireland. Show how you verify the account, objective, location/service area, budget, supplied creative and destination, then explain your checks before publishing. Briefly explain how you would validate Google Ads location and conversion settings as well. Stop before any live publication or spend. No access to our client accounts is needed for this screening video.



We are looking for accurate execution, evidence of results and reliable daily coverage. The agreed scope, schedule and pay will be confirmed with the selected candidate before work starts.

We are seeking a highly experienced, organized, and proactive Home Health Office Manager to oversee the daily administrative and operational functions of our California-based home health agency remotely.

Qualifications

PREFERRED: At least 1 year of direct home health office management experience.

Familiarity with home health EMR systems.



Experience with California-based home health agencies is highly preferred.



Knowledge of CMS regulations, OASIS workflows, and accreditation requirements is an advantage.



Excellent English communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.



Must be resourceful, detail-oriented, dependable, and able to work independently.



Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet home office.



IMPORTANT



This position is NOT intended for entry-level applicants or general Virtual Assistants without actual U.S. home health office management experience.

title: Meta Ads Account Manager for a Lead Generation Agency (Facebook and Instagram, Remote, Long-Term, $6/hr CAD)
description:
PAY

$6 CAD per hour to start, raised to $7 CAD per hour after a 60-day review, with room to grow into a senior role. At 20 to 30 hours a week that is roughly $520 to $780 CAD per month to start. Paid every two weeks by bank transfer to your Wise account or local bank.



HOURS

20 to 30 hours a week to start, growing toward full time as we add clients. You need at least 3 to 4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (Toronto) on working days, including Monday mornings Toronto time (Monday evenings in Manila), because that is when the weekly account checks happen.



ABOUT US

Acquirely is a Canadian agency that runs
 and Instagram lead generation for local service businesses (painters, renovators, dog trainers and other local companies). We judge every campaign by one thing: how many real jobs it books for the owner, not CPMs or link clicks. Each client gets a full system from us, which includes scripted video ads, image ads, a CRM with automatic text follow-up, a landing page and a weekly report. We are looking for someone who loves numbers, notices problems before the client does, and wants to own a set of accounts.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run a weekly check on every client account each Monday using our written rulebook, looking at cost per lead, CPM, link click-through rate, click-to-lead rate, ad frequency and cost per booked job.

- Turn each check into a short verdict for the account with no more than 3 clear next steps.

- Track creative supply. Make sure every client gets new scripts every 14 days, and follow up with clients who take more than 7 days to send their videos back to us.

- Check each client's CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) to make sure leads are being answered, quoted and moved through the stages, because ads cannot be judged when the pipeline is messy. Communicate with clients when this is not being done.

- Export weekly Meta data, prepare it for our reporting system, and help put together each client's weekly report.

- Launch new ads and make changes in Meta Ads Manager once approved, following our naming convention so every ad can be tracked.

- Keep client communication organized in Slack and help prepare for renewal calls near the end of each client's term.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of hands-on experience running
 and Instagram ads in Meta Ads Manager, ideally lead generation (lead forms or landing pages) for service businesses.

- You understand CPM, CTR, CPL, frequency, learning phase and ad fatigue, and you can explain why a campaign is getting worse.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets and with exporting and cleaning CSV data.

- Clear written and spoken English, because you will write notes that our team and sometimes our clients will read.

- Organized and dependable. You keep a checklist and finish it every week, you can work on your own, and you point out issues before they become a problem for the client.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM.

- You have managed several client accounts at once for an agency.

- You have looked at ad creative and said, with reasons, which hook will win.

- Comfort using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analysis.



HOW ACCESS WORKS

You start with view-only access to ad accounts and earn editing access after your first 30 days. Budget and campaign changes are always approved by the founders before they go live.



WHAT YOU GET

- Long-term work with a growing agency, with your hours increasing as we add clients.

- A raise to $7 CAD/hr after 60 days, and a path to a senior account manager role.

- Written playbooks for exactly how we judge an account, so you learn a real system for lead generation.

- Direct feedback from the founders, who still run ads themselves every week.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the items below.

2. Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test. We send you a week of real account data and you send back your verdict and next steps.

3. A short video call with the founders.

4. Start, with a 60-day review and raise.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "ACQ" so we know you read the whole post. Applications without it will not be opened.



In your application, include:

1. A short summary of the ad accounts you have run (industry, monthly budget, and the result you are proudest of).

2. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $6 CAD/hr starting rate, and how many hours a week you can work.

3. Your timezone, the hours you are usually online, and confirmation that you can cover at least 3 to 4 Eastern Time hours on working days, including Monday mornings.

4. Your answer to this question: "A campaign has a cost per lead that doubled in 2 weeks and a frequency of 3.2. What do you check first, and what would you suggest?"



Keep it short. We read every application that follows these steps.

title: Wix Studio Developer
description:
TYPE OF WORK

Gig / Project-Based (Non-Profit Website Build)



HOURS

Approximately 15-25 hours per week during active development



LOCATION

Remote



ABOUT THE ROLE



I am a graphic designer and creative director based in Detroit, Michigan (USA). I am hiring an experienced Wix Studio developer to build a nonprofit organization’s website from completed and approved Figma designs.



The site will include responsive page templates, reusable components, CMS-driven content, historical content migrated from the existing website, and several standard third-party tools and integrations.



This is not a general web developer position where Wix experience is optional. I need someone who knows the Wix ecosystem extremely well and can confidently translate a detailed visual design system into a polished, responsive and manageable Wix Studio website.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



I am looking for someone with:

• 6+ years of professional experience with Wix, Editor X and/or the broader Wix ecosystem

• 2+ years of strong hands-on Wix Studio experience

• Experience building complete production websites in Wix Studio

• Experience translating detailed Figma designs into responsive Wix Studio builds

• Strong knowledge of Wix CMS, dynamic pages, reusable components and responsive breakpoints

• Experience migrating existing website content, preserving URLs where needed, and preparing sites for launch

• Familiarity with forms, third-party integrations, redirects, basic SEO, accessibility and performance practices

• Strong visual judgment and attention to typography, spacing, alignment, scale, color and composition



Broader front-end or web development experience is valuable. Experience with Velo, JavaScript, APIs or custom code is also helpful, but deep Wix proficiency is the priority for this project.



THE WORK



You will help:

• Review completed Figma designs and flag technical issues before development

• Build approved page templates and responsive layouts in Wix Studio

• Create reusable components, CMS collections and dynamic content structures

• Migrate existing blog posts, press releases, reports and other archived content

• Preserve publication dates, chronology, categories, metadata and existing URLs where appropriate

• Configure forms, event/calendar functionality and standard third-party integrations

• Support external donation and ticket-purchasing pathways

• Complete redirects, responsive testing, cross-browser QA, revisions and launch preparation

• Organize the finished site so nonprofit staff can manage content after handoff



DESIGN SKILLS MATTER



Wix Studio is a visual development environment, so this role requires more than technical functionality.



You should be able to work closely from established Figma designs and notice inconsistencies in typography, spacing, hierarchy, alignment, scale, color and composition. The finished website should closely reflect the approved design system across desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints.



You will not be creating the brand or website design from scratch. Your role is to translate an established design system accurately and thoughtfully into Wix Studio.



WORKING TOGETHER



We will communicate through
, Wix Studio, Slack, Figma and Zoom or Google Meet. You should be comfortable sharing work in progress, communicating questions or blockers early, receiving detailed design feedback and giving regular updates.



Most work can happen on your own schedule. One scheduled meeting each week and occasional overlap with Detroit Eastern Time will be needed. Meeting times will be arranged in advance with reasonable flexibility across time zones.



The project will include lighter planning periods and more concentrated development, migration, revision and QA periods.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



"WIX STUDIO"



Then send:



1. 2–3 LIVE WEBSITE EXAMPLES

Share 2–3 websites you personally helped develop. Wix Studio projects are strongly preferred, with Wix Editor or Editor X projects also welcome.



For each, briefly tell me:

• Which Wix platform you used

• What you personally built

• Approximately how long development took

• How you worked from design through development, testing and launch



2. WIX EXPERIENCE

Briefly describe your experience with Wix Studio, Editor X/Wix Editor, Wix CMS and developing from Figma designs.



3. CONTENT MIGRATION

In a few sentences, explain how you would approach moving an existing archive of blog posts, press releases and reports into a new Wix Studio site while preserving dates, chronology and existing URLs where possible.



4. AVAILABILITY

Please include:

• Your current hourly rate

• Your general weekly availability

• Your time zone

• Whether you are currently working on other major projects



Short, direct applications are welcome. I am most interested in seeing strong Wix work, understanding exactly what you contributed to it, and finding someone who knows Wix Studio extremely well.

title: E-Commerce Developer: Kickflip Customizer Build, GMC Variant Feeds, WooCommerce Plugin Audit & Shopify Migration
description:
We are an established custom golf gear and apparel manufacturing brand currently operating on WooCommerce. We are seeking a skilled e-commerce developer with hands-on experience building visual product configurators and troubleshooting complex feed architectures. Our immediate priorities are building our interactive product builder on Kickflip, solving Google Merchant Center product variation feed issues and bot crawling bottlenecks, cleaning up our current WooCommerce plugin stack, and preparing for an eventual migration to Shopify. In order to be considered, when you apply to this job write the word yothar in the subject line when you contact us and include an audio file or link of you talking so that we can hear your English prior to interviewing you.





Core Responsibilities (In Order of Priority):

1) Kickflip Product Configurator Build-Out (Primary Focus):

*Work on the setup, asset mapping, and conditional logic configuration for our custom golf headcovers and gear inside the Kickflip platform.

*Configure multi-view options, color palettes, material layers, text personalization, and custom logo upload features.

*Ensure customizer output cleanly maps print-ready production files, preview render URLs, and line-item properties directly into the cart and checkout payloads.



2) WooCommerce Plugin Audit & Conflict Resolution:

*Audit our current WordPress/WooCommerce plugin stack (SiteGround environment) to eliminate redundancies, database bloat, and filter/hook conflicts.

*Safely deprecate, remove, or consolidate unnecessary plugins without breaking checkout workflows or our live conversion tracking.

*Streamline site speed, reduce heavy database queries, and clean up asset loading across product and checkout pages.



3)Google Merchant Center & Variation Feed Management:

*Audit and resolve product feed errors in Google Merchant Center (GL&A / custom feeds), specifically around parent-child variation mapping, item_group_id, color/material attributes, and missing identifiers.

*Optimize server response, caching, and WooCommerce dynamic URLs to ensure Google Ads and Google Shopping bots crawl variant parameters efficiently without server timeouts or index bloat.

*Ensure customizer products have clear base-product representation in Shopping feeds while custom configurations stay within Merchant Center specifications.



4) Shopify Architecture & Migration Planning:

*Evaluate our current product catalog, variation structures, and Kickflip setups for a future transition from WooCommerce over to Shopify.

*Advise on Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme architecture, native web pixels, and collection/variant setups to ensure zero downtime or conversion data loss when the migration takes place.



Requirements & Qualifications:

*Direct, verifiable experience building or integrating visual customizers/configurators (specifically Kickflip; experience with Zakeke or similar visual engines is also relevant).



*Strong WooCommerce backend proficiency (PHP, WordPress hooks/filters, REST API, MySQL, plugin conflict debugging).



*Technical knowledge of Google Merchant Center feeds, Shopping attributes (item_group_id, variant titling, GTIN/MPN exemptions), and handling bot crawl behavior on dynamic variant pages.



*Working knowledge of Shopify development (Liquid, Shopify Online Store 2.0, Theme App Extensions, line-item properties).



*Understanding of e-commerce conversion tracking (Google Ads conversion actions, enhanced conversions, server-side data layers) so code and feed edits never interrupt ad attribution.



*Excellent written English and proactive communication during project milestones.

The applicant will need to work on US Central Time zone, 9AM-5PM M-F, 40 hrs/week with weekends off.  Depending on qualifications and experience, there may be some flexibility potential with working hours. 





Here are some questions for extra credit:

1) "How do you pass Kickflip render URLs and personalized print specs into cart/order line items without bloating checkout load times or database storage?"

2) "What is your protocol for auditing/removing WooCommerce plugins without breaking active Google Ads conversion tags, server datalayers, or dynamic value reporting?"

3) "How do you structure complex customizable product feeds in Google Merchant Center to prevent bot crawl traps, server timeouts, and variant disapprovals?"

title: Sales Development Rep (SDR) | Book Meetings With US Agency Owners | Only 4 Hours of Night-Shift Calling
description:
You'll be calling US agency owners with one of the easiest offers to say yes to in B2B sales. We put up the money. They only pay when qualified sales meetings we booked for their sales teams happen.



ABOUT AXION



Axion is a performance-based pipeline partner for US marketing agencies. We fund and run the campaigns and SDR teams that put qualified business owners on our partners' sales calendars, using the same playbooks behind our own agencies.



Our partners pay only when a qualified owner shows up to a meeting with their sales team. No retainers, no setup fees, no long-term contracts. We invest our own capital first and only get paid when our partners do.



Feel free to learn more about Axion at 
 



THE ROLE



You'll book the first conversation between a marketing agency CEO and Axion.



Half your day is on the phone with agency owners across the US. The other half is research: finding the agencies we want to work with and building the list you call. Your job is to start the right conversations and get great agencies onto our calendar. Our team handles the rest.



Why this role stands out:



- Only 4 hours of night shift. Your calling block is 10am to 2pm US Eastern (currently 10pm to 2am Philippine time). Your research hours are yours to schedule.

- An offer owners want to hear. Agencies take on zero risk and pay only for meetings that happen. That makes every cold call warmer.

- One company, one offer. No rotating client campaigns. You'll learn this offer deeply and get very good at it.

- Direct coaching. You work directly with Adam, our VP of Partner Success, with a short huddle before every calling block and a recap after.

- Real growth. Hit your targets for 90 days and you move to Senior SDR with a higher base and bigger bonuses. The Axion team is constantly growing, and leadership roles go to the people already here.



WHAT A DAY LOOKS LIKE



- Research (about 4 hours, on your schedule): find US marketing agencies through Google and LinkedIn, check what they sell, review their case studies, confirm their US team size, and add the strong ones to your list.

- Huddle (15 minutes): role-play, objections, and the plan for the day.

- Calling block (10am to 2pm Eastern): call agency owners and CEOs, send follow-up
s, leave voi
s, and book fit calls onto our calendar.

- Recap (15 minutes): your numbers, your best calls, and what to sharpen tomorrow.



PAY



- $700/month base, in USD

- $25 for every qualified fit call you book that shows up

- $150 for every agency you book that becomes a partner within 6 months

- Senior SDR after 90 days at target: $900/month base, $35 per attended fit call, $200 per new partner

- Paid twice a month, straight to your Wise/Payoneer account

- At target, new SDRs earn about $1,100 to $1,400 a month



WHO YOU ARE



You're competitive. You take coaching and use it on your very next call. A "no" doesn't slow you down. You're curious about how marketing agencies grow, and you want a long-term role with a company you can grow inside.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken English that sounds natural to US business owners

- B2B cold calling or appointment setting experience with US companies (strongly preferred)

- An active LinkedIn account

- Wired headset and a quiet place to work

- Reliable internet, plus a backup plan if your power or internet drops

- A computer that runs Chrome with several tabs open

- Available Monday to Friday, 10am to 2pm US Eastern



HOW TO APPLY



We listen to every recording before we read anything else. Send all of the following:



1. Subject line: Axion SDR | [Your Name]

2. A voice recording of you reading the script below. Upload it to Google Drive or Vocaroo and paste the link. Say it the way you would on a live call.

3. Your LinkedIn profile link

4. Short answers to these questions:

   a. Tell us about your cold calling experience: who you called, what you booked, and your best month.

   b. An agency owner tells you, "We get all our clients from referrals." What do you say next?

   c. What's your backup if your internet or power goes out during your shift?

   d. What's a goal you're working toward right now, and how would this role help you get there?



Applications without a recording won't be reviewed.



SCRIPT FOR YOUR RECORDING



"Hi Mark, this is [your name] with Axion. I know I'm calling out of the blue, so I'll be quick. We work with marketing agencies that already have a strong sales team and want more qualified prospects on their sales team’s calendars. We fund the outreach ourselves, and agencies only pay for the meetings that are qualified and actually show. I'm not calling to sell you anything today. I just wanted to see if it makes sense to set up a quick 15-minute call this week to see if we're a fit. Would Thursday or Friday work better for you?"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. Shortlisted applicants hear from us within 2 business days.

2. A 15-minute live call with a quick role-play.

3. If it's a fit, you start with one focused, paid training day.

4. Day two, you're on the phones.



We're hiring this week.
